`측정 2026-10-12 · cloudflared 2026.10.0 deb from pkg.cloudflare.com, Ubuntu 26.04, locally managed tunnel as a custom systemd unit`

**증상:** A host ran cloudflared from a hand-copied `/usr/local/bin/cloudflared` (no package, so never updated). `apt-get install cloudflared` from the Cloudflare repo, over an ssh session that itself went through that tunnel, dropped the session (`Connection to <host>-ssh closed by remote host`). Journal: `Stopping cloudflared.service` at 11:40:47, `Registered tunnel connection` at 11:41:17 — every hostname on the tunnel was down for 30 s. Afterwards `/usr/local/bin/cloudflared` was a symlink to `/usr/bin/cloudflared`. dpkg still finished (`status installed`), because the install was not tied to the dropped session.

**해결:** Run the install at a maintenance time and over a path that does not use the tunnel (`ssh <name>.local` on the LAN), or with `systemd-run --no-block` so a dropped session cannot interrupt it. Point the unit at `/usr/bin/cloudflared` with a drop-in (`ExecStart=` then the new `ExecStart=`). Never replace the running binary by hand (`ln -sf` + `mv`) before the target exists: the unit's next restart then fails and takes every tunnel hostname down. If that happened, the deleted binary is still at `/proc/$(pidof cloudflared)/exe` — copy it back.

## OPS-418 — `echo "$PW" | sudo -S cmd <<EOF` writes the password, not the heredoc, into `cmd`'s stdin once sudo has cached the credential

`측정 2026-10-12 · sudo 1.9 (Ubuntu 26.04), bash, helper S() { echo "$PW" | sudo -S -p '' "$@"; }`

**증상:** With a helper like `S()` above, `S tee /etc/x <<'EOF' … EOF` and `S python3 - <<'PY'` did not get the heredoc. The pipe inside the function replaces stdin, so the command reads whatever sudo left on it. On the first call sudo consumes the password line and the command gets EOF (empty file: an empty systemd unit counts as **masked** — `Failed to enable unit: … is masked`). After sudo has cached the credential it reads nothing, and the command receives the password itself: a script and a unit file each held the password, and `python3 -` printed it back in a `SyntaxError`.

**해결:** Never give `sudo -S` a command that also needs stdin. Write content to a user-owned temp file (or `scp` it) and `sudo install -m 644 /tmp/f /etc/x`; or use `sudo -A`/`NOPASSWD` for that command. After a slip, check with `sudo grep -cF -- "$PW" <files>` and rewrite every file that matches.

## OPS-419 — Moving a Dokploy install moves the database, not the deploy state in the host user's home: a missing bind-mount file comes back as a root-owned directory and the container runs without its secret

`측정 2026-10-12 · Dokploy v0.30.8 raw compose · Docker 29.9 (target) / 28.5 (source) · Ubuntu 26.04`

**증상:** After moving every stack to a new Dokploy host (OPS-410), the sites answered `200` and health checks passed. On the new host `~/.config/landgrabs/age_secret` was a **directory owned by root**, and the stack's own deploy state under `~/.config/<app>/` (`deployment.json`, generated secrets, publish logs) was missing for 12 apps. Copying it later failed with `tar: landgrabs/deployment.json: Cannot open: Permission denied` because Docker had created the parent directory as root.

A compose file that bind-mounts a host **file** (`${SECRET_FILE}:/run/secrets/x:ro`) whose path does not exist makes Docker create an empty **directory** at that path, as root, and start the container anyway. The healthcheck only probed `/healthz`, so nothing failed; any feature that reads the secret runs without it. The release scripts that keep `composeId` and generated passwords in `~/.config/<app>/deployment.json` would, without that file, take the "first deploy" path on their next run.

**해결:** Before moving, list what the host user's home carries: `ls ~/.config ~/.mnori-deploy` and every bind source, `docker inspect -f '{{.Name}} {{range .Mounts}}{{if eq .Type "bind"}}{{.Source}} {{end}}{{end}}' $(docker ps -aq)`. Copy them with `tar -czf - … | ssh new 'tar -C ~/.config -xpzf -'`. If a directory was already created in a file's place: `sudo rmdir` it, `chown` the parent back, copy the file, then recreate only that service (`docker compose -p <appName> up -d --force-recreate --no-deps <svc>` in `/etc/dokploy/compose/<appName>/code`; a plain `docker restart` keeps the old mount). Check with `docker exec <c> test -f /run/secrets/x`.

## OPS-420 — A unit ordered `After=` a service that is itself `After=multi-user.target` must not be `WantedBy=multi-user.target`: systemd breaks the cycle by silently dropping it at boot

`측정 2026-10-12 · systemd 259 (Ubuntu 26.04)`

**증상:** A new service `nj-lid.service` (`After=nj-powersave.service`, `WantedBy=multi-user.target`) was `active` after `systemctl enable --now`, but after the next boot it was `inactive` with no failure. `systemctl --failed` is empty. Only the boot journal says so:
`multi-user.target: Found ordering cycle: nj-lid.service/start after nj-powersave.service/start after multi-user.target/start - after nj-lid.service` and `Job nj-lid.service/start deleted to break ordering cycle`. `nj-powersave.service` had `After=multi-user.target`, and a target is implicitly ordered after every unit it wants.

**해결:** Hang the unit on the service it follows: `[Install] WantedBy=nj-powersave.service` (plus `After=nj-powersave.service`), so `multi-user.target` no longer wants it. `systemd-analyze verify` did not report the cycle; test with a real reboot and `journalctl -b | grep "ordering cycle"`.

## OPS-421 — Wake-on-LAN from soft-off works on an HP Pavilion (r8169) whose NIC root port lists S5 in `/proc/acpi/wakeup`; the ASUS with an S4 port is not a candidate

`측정 2026-10-12 · HP Pavilion (BIOS F.80, r8169 100 Mb), ASUS ROG Strix G712LU (r8169 1 GbE), Ubuntu 26.04`

**증상:** Whether a laptop server can be woken after a power cut is not in any spec sheet, and `ethtool` reports `Supports Wake-on: pumbg` on both machines either way. The column that differs is the S-state of the NIC's PCIe root port in `/proc/acpi/wakeup` (the port is the parent of `/sys/class/net/<nic>/device`): HP `RP09 S5 *enabled`, ASUS `RP15 S4 *enabled`.

Measured on the HP: `ethtool -s eno1 wol g` armed, a 15-minute RTC alarm set as fallback (`rtcwake -m no -s 900`), `systemctl poweroff` at 20:54:41; the other server sent a magic packet (UDP broadcast to port 9, socket bound to its NIC with `SO_BINDTODEVICE`) at 20:55:27, and the HP's next boot started at 20:55:37 — 10 s later, long before the RTC alarm.

**해결:** Read the root port's S-state first; S5 means power-off wake is possible, S4 only from hibernate. Arm WoL persistently with netplan `wakeonlan: true` (it writes `WakeOnLan=magic` into the generated `.link`) and re-arm it periodically, since `powertop --auto-tune` can turn it off. A laptop with a dead battery goes off at any power blip; a peer that rides the cut out on its own battery can then wake it.

## OPS-422 — Moving a Prometheus/Grafana stack to another host carries the old host's disk rules along: an `or on() vector(100)` "missing mount" rule fires on the new host, and dropping it from provisioning does not delete it

`측정 2026-10-12 · Grafana 13.0.7 (file-provisioned alert rules) · Prometheus v3.14.0 · node-exporter v1.12.1 · Dokploy raw compose`

**증상:** A day after the whole Dokploy install moved hosts (OPS-410), the e-mail alert "backup disk `/mnt/hdd` over 80 % or not mounted" fired. The old host's HDD was mounted and 1 % used. The monitoring stack had moved with everything else, and its node-exporter now read the new host, which has one NVMe and no `/mnt/hdd`. The rule's `… or on() vector(100)` (OPS-240 follow-up 4) is built to turn a missing mount into 100 %, so it fired exactly as designed. The static scrape label `instance: <old host>` had also come along, so every graph showed the new machine under the old name.

**해결:** After moving a monitoring stack, grep its compose for the old host name and for host-specific mount points, and fix both with the move. To remove a file-provisioned Grafana rule, deleting its block is not enough; the stored rule stays. Add to the same provisioning file:
```yaml
deleteRules:
  - orgId: 1
    uid: <rule uid>
```
then apply it as in OPS-243 (patch `compose.one`'s `composeFile`, deploy, `up -d --force-recreate --no-deps grafana prometheus`). Check the result in a copy of `grafana.db` (`docker cp`, then `select uid from alert_rule`) when no admin password is at hand. Renaming the scrape label leaves the old series in instant queries for 5 minutes (Prometheus lookback), so per-instance rules see two series until then.

## OPS-423 — A host behind a home/office router cannot reach its own public hostname (no NAT loopback); `curl --resolve <host>:443:127.0.0.1` goes through the local Traefik with the real certificate

`측정 2026-10-13 · Ubuntu host behind a Korean ISP router, Dokploy Traefik with Let's Encrypt · Uptime Kuma 1.23.16 push monitor`

**증상:** a systemd job on the host that runs Uptime Kuma pushed its heartbeat to `https://uptime.<domain>/api/push/<token>` and got `curl: (28) Connection timed out after 10006 milliseconds`. The same URL worked from outside. The name resolves to the host's own public IP, and the router does not forward a connection from inside the LAN back to the LAN (no hairpin / NAT loopback). The Kuma container publishes no port (`"3001/tcp":null`), so `127.0.0.1:3001` refuses too.

**해결:** keep the public URL and pin the name to the local reverse proxy: `curl -fsS -m 10 --resolve uptime.<domain>:443:127.0.0.1 -G "$url" --data-urlencode status=up --data-urlencode msg=…`. TLS still checks the real certificate, and the URL in the config file stays the one that works from anywhere. Test a new push from the host it will run on, not from your own machine. Uptime Kuma's own Python client (`uptime-kuma-api`) generates the push token itself; `add_monitor(pushToken=…)` raises `TypeError`, so read it back with `get_monitor(id)["pushToken"]`.

## OPS-424 — A Dokploy API key made through `user.createApiKey` stops after 10 calls a day and then answers `Unauthorized`, not 429

`측정 2026-10-13 · Dokploy v0.30.8 (better-auth apikey plugin), postgres:16`

**증상:** a key created from the shell worked for 10 REST calls (`x-api-key`), then every call, including `GET /api/project.all`, returned `401 {"message":"Unauthorized"}`. Nothing says a limit was hit. In the `apikey` table the row had `rate_limit_enabled = t`, `rate_limit_time_window = 86400000`, `rate_limit_max = 10`, `request_count = 10`: better-auth's defaults, used when the create call does not set them. Keys made in the panel on another install had `rate_limit_enabled = f`.

Making a key without the panel: `POST /api/auth/sign-in/email` with `{"email","password"}` and an `origin` header (keep the cookie), `GET /api/trpc/organization.all` for the organization id, then `POST /api/trpc/user.createApiKey` with `{"json":{"name":"cli","metadata":{"organizationId":"<id>"}}}`. The key is in `result.data.json.key`. The REST paths (`/api/<router>.<proc>`) reject the session cookie (`401`); only `/api/trpc/…` takes it. If the admin has 2FA, sign-in returns `twoFactorRedirect` and the cookie is only `better-auth.two_factor` (OPS-416).

**해결:** add `"rateLimitEnabled": false` to the create input, or afterwards `update apikey set rate_limit_enabled=false, request_count=0 where name='cli'` in `dokploy-postgres`. Takes effect on the next call, no restart.

## OPS-425 — A shell function with its own `< file` redirect ignores the heredoc at the call site: `S python3 - <<EOF` ran the password file as Python and printed it

`측정 2026-10-13 · bash 5 on Ubuntu 26.04, over ssh`

**증상:** with `S(){ sudo -S -p '' "$@" </tmp/.p; }` (password in `/tmp/.p` for `sudo -S`), the call `S python3 - <<EOF … EOF` did not run the heredoc. Python got the password file as its program and failed with `SyntaxError`, and the error message quoted the line, so the password was printed to the terminal and the log.

A redirect written in the function definition is applied each time the function runs, after the redirects of the call, so it replaces the heredoc on stdin. `sudo -S` reads its password from that same stdin, so the program behind it gets the rest of it.

**해결:** never give a command its input on stdin through such a helper. Write the script or file first (`cat > /tmp/x.py`, `scp`), then `S python3 /tmp/x.py` or `S install -m 644 /tmp/new /etc/target`. Better still, `sudo -A` with `SUDO_ASKPASS`, which leaves stdin alone.

## OPS-426 — GitLab: let a deploy key push to a protected `main` with one PATCH; it adds to the existing push rule

`측정 2026-10-13 · gitlab.com (Free), REST API v4, glab 1.x`

**증상:** a job on a home server had to push a commit to `main` of a GitLab.com project. `main` was protected with "Allowed to push: Maintainers", and a deploy key created with `can_push=true` still cannot push there until the protected branch names it.

`PATCH /projects/:id/protected_branches/main` with a JSON body `{"allowed_to_push":[{"deploy_key_id":<id>}]}` adds the key and keeps the existing `Maintainers` level: the response listed both (`[('Maintainers', None), ('<title>', <id>)]`). No unprotect/re-protect, so there is no window with `main` unprotected. The first push from the key then went through and started a normal pipeline.

**해결:**
1. `glab api -X POST "projects/:id/deploy_keys" -f title=… -f key="$(cat key.pub)" -F can_push=true` → note `id`.
2. `glab api -X PATCH "projects/:id/protected_branches/main" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --input - <<<'{"allowed_to_push":[{"deploy_key_id":<id>}]}'`.
3. On the host, push with `GIT_SSH_COMMAND="ssh -i <key> -o IdentitiesOnly=yes"`. Check the host key against GitLab's published fingerprint (`SHA256:eUXGGm1YGsMAS7vkcx6JOJdOGHPem5gQp4taiCfCLB8` for ed25519) before trusting `ssh-keyscan` output.

## OPS-427 — `ssh` through a Cloudflare Tunnel says `websocket: bad handshake` while that host's cloudflared restarts; reach it from a LAN peer with `ssh -A`

`측정 2026-10-13 · cloudflared access ssh (ProxyCommand), cloudflared systemd service on Ubuntu 26.04`

**증상:** `ssh <host>` (ProxyCommand `cloudflared access ssh --hostname <host>-ssh.<domain>`) failed three times in a row, a minute after it had worked:

```
websocket: bad handshake
Connection closed by UNKNOWN port 65535
```

The host was fine. Its `journalctl -u cloudflared` showed the service had just been restarted (`Started cloudflared.service` followed by new `Registered tunnel connection` lines); another session had restarted it. The edge answers the WebSocket upgrade with an error until the tunnel registers again, and the message names neither the tunnel nor the host.

**해결:** do not retry in a tight loop or blame the ssh key. Reach the host from another machine on its LAN and look at cloudflared there. A peer usually has no key of its own for the host (`Permission denied (publickey)`), so forward yours: `ssh-add ~/.ssh/id_ed25519; ssh -A <peer> 'ssh -o BatchMode=yes <host>.local "journalctl -u cloudflared -n 20 --no-pager"'`. In this case the tunnel was back within about a minute and plain `ssh <host>` worked again.

## OPS-428 — Unattended ssh into a macOS host through a Cloudflare Tunnel with Access: turn on Zero Trust (free) first, create the service token through the dashboard session, and pass it to `cloudflared access ssh` as environment variables

`측정 2026-10-13 · cloudflared 2026.10.0 (client, Homebrew) · cloudflare/cloudflared:latest in a colima 0.10.3 vz VM · Cloudflare Zero Trust free · macOS 27.0.1 (MacBook Air M1)`

**증상:** a test host had to take `ssh` from automated sessions on any network. Its sshd allows passwords and the account has no sudo, so a tunnel hostname without Access would be open to anyone who has `cloudflared` (OPS-405). Three things stood in the way:

- Every `/accounts/<id>/access/*` call answered `9999 access.api.error.not_enabled: Access is not enabled.` The account had never been through Zero Trust onboarding.
- After onboarding, a user API token with zone DNS/SSL/settings edit could **read** `access/apps` and `access/service_tokens` but `POST access/service_tokens` answered `1010 auth.forbidden`. The `client_secret` is shown only in the create response, so a pipeline that fails after the POST loses it: delete the token and create a new one.
- `cloudflared access ssh` without a token prints `A browser window should have opened at the following URL` and waits, which hangs an unattended session.

**해결:**

1. Zero Trust onboarding in the dashboard (signed-in Playwright profile): `one/overview` → 「시작하기」 → the free plan's 「요금제 선택」 → checkout page. 「활성화」 does nothing until both terms checkboxes are ticked; they are hidden `<input>`s, so click `getByRole('checkbox')`, not `input[type=checkbox]` (Playwright says "Element is outside of the viewport"). The plan is $0 and used the card already on file. A team domain `<random-words>.cloudflareaccess.com` is assigned with no prompt.
2. Make the Access objects through the dashboard session (OPS-301: `fetch('/api/v4/…', {headers: {'x-cross-site-security': 'dash'}})`), writing the response straight to a 0600 file: `POST access/service_tokens {"name":…,"duration":"forever"}` (it returned `expires_at` 2126), then `POST access/apps` with `type: self_hosted`, `domain: <host>` and inline `policies`: `{"decision":"non_identity","include":[{"service_token":{"token_id":<id>}}]}` for sessions and `{"decision":"allow","include":[{"email":{"email":<owner>}}]}` for a person with email OTP.
3. Tunnel: `POST cfd_tunnel {"config_src":"cloudflare"}`, `PUT …/configurations` with ingress `ssh://host.docker.internal:22`, `GET …/token` into an env file, CNAME `<tunnel-id>.cfargotunnel.com` proxied. On a Mac behind LuLu run it in its own colima profile (OPS-299) with `--add-host host.docker.internal:host-gateway`; sshd then sees the session from `127.0.0.1`.
4. Client: `ProxyCommand /bin/sh -c 'set -a; . ~/.config/cloudflare/<host>-access.env; exec cloudflared access ssh --hostname %h'` with `TUNNEL_SERVICE_TOKEN_ID` and `TUNNEL_SERVICE_TOKEN_SECRET` in the file. Use `HostKeyAlias <host>.local` to reuse the LAN host key.

Measured: a full `ssh` round trip (connect, run `hostname` and `node -v`, exit) took 1.49 s; `rsync -az` of 5 MB took 2.2 s. Without the token, plain `https://<host>/` answers 302 to the Access login and `cloudflared access ssh` stops at the browser prompt. After `colima stop`, a LaunchAgent (`RunAtLoad`, `StartInterval 300`) running `colima start` and `docker start` brought ssh back 32 s after `launchctl kickstart`. Save `docker context show` before `colima start` and restore it afterwards, or other sessions' `docker` commands land in the new VM.

Reboot test, same day: without sudo, `osascript -e 'tell application "loginwindow" to «event aevtrrst»'` over ssh returned 0 and did nothing (no reboot, nothing in the loginwindow log). `osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to restart'` over ssh also returned 0 and did restart the Mac (auto-login on). From the moment ssh stopped answering: LAN ssh back after 30 s, `ssh air` through the tunnel back after 48 s (40 s after boot, load average 102 at that moment), with the LaunchAgents' other services up too.

## OPS-429 — A private `registry:2` fed by repeated `:latest` pushes keeps every old build: `garbage-collect --delete-untagged` took it from 18 GB to 4.7 GB; check pinned service digests first and restart the registry after

`측정 2026-10-13 · registry:2 (go1.20.8) on Docker inside an OrbStack Ubuntu VM (btrfs root), Dokploy swarm services pulling localhost:5000/<app>:latest`

**증상:** the `registry-data` volume was 18 GB for five repositories. Each deploy pushes `<app>:latest`, the tag moves to the new manifest, and the old manifest stays in `_manifests/revisions` with no tag: one repository had 166 revisions for 5 tags. A plain `registry garbage-collect` frees none of it, because untagged manifests still count as references. `docker image prune -f` on the host (OPS-240) does not touch the registry volume either.

**해결:**
1. Compare each swarm service's pinned digest (`docker service inspect <svc> --format '{{.Spec.TaskTemplate.ContainerSpec.Image}}'`, the part after `@`) with the tag's current digest (`cat <volume>/_data/docker/registry/v2/repositories/<repo>/_manifests/tags/latest/current/link`). A service pinned to an untagged digest loses its manifest in the GC and cannot be rescheduled.
2. Make sure nothing is pushing: `docker logs --since 30m registry | grep -c -E 'PUT|PATCH'` should be 0.
3. `docker exec registry registry garbage-collect --dry-run --delete-untagged /etc/docker/registry/config.yml` (1,480 blobs listed), then the same without `--dry-run`. Every named tag (rollback tags such as `pre-*`) is kept.
4. `docker restart registry`: its in-memory blob cache still lists deleted layers, and a later push of the same layer would skip the upload.
5. Check: `curl http://localhost:5000/v2/_catalog` and a `GET /v2/<repo>/manifests/latest` with the manifest `Accept` headers returned 200 for all five repositories.

On a btrfs root (OrbStack VM), `df /` showed the same 55 GB used right after the GC; after `sync` it showed 41 GB. The macOS host freed the same 14 GB (99 GB to 85 GB used) because OrbStack mounts the disk with `discard`. Related: OPS-092, OPS-240.

## OPS-430 — A macOS host with sudo needs no container for a Cloudflare Tunnel: run cloudflared as its own LaunchDaemon with `--token-file`; a user API token without Tunnel/Access scope lists them as empty with `success: true`

`측정 2026-10-13 · cloudflared 2026.10.0 (Homebrew) · macOS 27.0.1 (Mac mini M6) · Cloudflare Zero Trust free`

**증상:** two traps while giving a second Mac `ssh` from any network the same way as OPS-428:

- `GET /accounts/<id>/cfd_tunnel`, `access/apps` and `access/service_tokens` with a user API token that has zone DNS rights but no Tunnel/Access scope answered `"success": true, "errors": [], "result": []`, although a tunnel, an Access app and a service token existed. Nothing says the token lacks the scope; the same calls through the dashboard session (OPS-301) listed them.
- OPS-428 ran cloudflared in a colima VM because that Air has no sudo and runs LuLu. That costs a 1 GiB VM and a LaunchAgent that only starts after login.

**해결:** treat an empty list from a user API token as "maybe no permission" and check through the dashboard session before creating duplicates. On a Mac where the account has sudo, skip the container:

1. `brew install cloudflared`; write the tunnel token (`GET …/cfd_tunnel/<id>/token`) to `/etc/cloudflared/<name>.token`, root 0600, by piping it over ssh so it is never printed.
2. Tunnel ingress `ssh://localhost:22` (no `host.docker.internal`); sshd then sees sessions from `::1` (`$SSH_CLIENT` = `::1 <port> 22`).
3. `/Library/LaunchDaemons/com.<org>.<name>-tunnel.plist` with `ProgramArguments` `cloudflared tunnel --no-autoupdate run --token-file /etc/cloudflared/<name>.token`, `RunAtLoad`, `KeepAlive`, root:wheel 644, then `sudo launchctl bootstrap system <plist>`. The token stays out of the world-readable plist, which putting it on the command line would not do.

Measured: four tunnel connections registered within 6 s of bootstrap. A full `ssh` round trip (connect, `hostname`, exit) took 0.56–0.74 s over three runs. After `sudo pkill` of cloudflared, launchd restarted it (`runs = 2`) and `ssh` through the tunnel answered on the first try 2 s later. Without the service token, `https://<host>/` answers 302 to the Access login, as in OPS-428.

Reboot test, same day (`sudo shutdown -r now` over LAN ssh): ssh stopped answering 2 s later; LAN ssh was back after 30 s and `ssh` through the tunnel after 34 s, with no login needed (the LaunchDaemon started cloudflared at boot and its four connections registered within 3 s). A home internet outage the same day dropped both this tunnel and the Air's (OPS-428) at 08:39 UTC with `timeout: no recent network activity`. The Air's containerised cloudflared exited (`no more connections active and exiting`), Docker restarted it, and it was back 19 s later; the native one stayed in its own retry backoff and re-registered only at 08:41:12, about 2 minutes after the drop. During that gap `ssh` answered `websocket: bad handshake` (as in OPS-427) while LAN ssh worked.

## OPS-431 — Replace a colima-VM cloudflared tunnel with a native launchd cloudflared on a LuLu Mac: allow it once in LuLu, and point the remote-managed ingress at `localhost` (not `host.docker.internal`)

`측정 2026-10-13 · macOS 27.0.1 (MacBook Air M1) · cloudflared 2026.10.0 (native, Developer ID "Cloudflare Inc. 68WVV388M8") · LuLu (allowApple, not passive) · remotely-managed Cloudflare Tunnel (source: cloudflare)`

**증상:** a test host reached over ssh through a Cloudflare Tunnel (OPS-428) ran cloudflared inside a dedicated colima VM only because LuLu blocks new binaries' outbound (OPS-299). The VM's 1 GiB reservation was wasted for a job that needs ~44 MB. Moving to a native launchd cloudflared hit two walls:

- A downloaded native cloudflared registered its tunnel connections but every request failed with `dial tcp: lookup host.docker.internal: no such host`. The tunnel's ingress was `ssh://host.docker.internal:22`, which only resolves **inside** the old container (where `--add-host host.docker.internal:host-gateway` mapped it); on the host there is no such name. Running the native connector alongside the still-up colima connector made ssh ~50 % flaky, because Cloudflare load-balances across all connections and half dialed the dead name.
- The tunnel is **remotely-managed** (`"source":"cloudflare"`), so cloudflared pulls the server-side ingress and **ignores any local `config.yml`** — even when started with `--config` and a credentials file built from the token. The ingress must be changed server-side. The user API token (zone-scoped) is `1001 Not authorized` on `GET/PUT /accounts/:id/cfd_tunnel/:id/configurations`.

**해결:**

1. Install the native binary at its final path first (LuLu keys a rule to the path + signing id, so don't move it later): `~/.local/bin/cloudflared`. Write a LaunchAgent (`RunAtLoad`, `KeepAlive`) whose wrapper sources the tunnel token and runs `cloudflared tunnel --no-autoupdate run`.
2. LuLu's allow needs one human click on the host's screen (ssh cannot see or answer the alert — OPS-299); choose **Always**. The persistent rule is then keyed by the Developer ID `Cloudflare Inc. (68WVV388M8)` and the path, so it survives reboot and `--no-autoupdate` keeps the path stable. Confirm the tunnel works rather than decoding `rules.plist`.
3. Change the remote ingress to `ssh://localhost:22`. The token can't, so use the signed-in dashboard session (OPS-301/428): a Brave on CDP `:9333` with a `dash.cloudflare.com` tab, and `fetch('/api/v4/accounts/:id/cfd_tunnel/:id/configurations',{method:'PUT',headers:{'x-cross-site-security':'dash','content-type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({config:{ingress:[{service:'ssh://localhost:22',hostname:'<host>'},{service:'http_status:404'}],'warp-routing':{enabled:false}}})})`. It returned `version:2`, and the running cloudflared picked it up with no restart.
4. Tear down the old path: `launchctl bootout gui/501/<old-agent>`, `docker --context colima-<profile> rm -f <container>`, `colima stop <profile>`, `colima delete -f <profile>`. `colima delete` switches the global docker context, so restore it afterwards.

Measured: native RSS 44 MB vs the VM's 1 GiB cap; 10/10 ssh round trips through the tunnel after the colima connector was gone (while both ran, 3/5). Keep the home-LAN path (`ssh -o HostKeyAlias=<host>.local <user>@<host>.local`) open during the cutover — it is independent of the tunnel, so a wrong ingress cannot lock you out.

## OPS-432 — A Wi-Fi Apple-silicon Mac put to sleep wakes from a LAN magic packet only into a 10 s DarkWake; `caffeinate -u` over ssh in that window makes it a full wake, and ping cannot tell whether it is up

`측정 2026-10-13 · Mac mini (Mac18,5) on Wi-Fi, macOS 27.0.1 · waker: M1 MacBook Air on the same Wi-Fi LAN · Bonjour Sleep Proxy on an Apple TV/HomePod`

**증상:** After `pmset sleepnow` (no sudo needed), a magic packet from a LAN peer and a TCP connect to the sleeping Mac's port 22 both woke it, but `pmset -g log` shows only `DarkWake from Deep Idle [CDNP] : due to … wifibt … E_RX_IP_PACKET`, followed 10 s later by `Entering Sleep state due to 'Maintenance Sleep'`. Its Cloudflare tunnel did not come back in that window. `ping` from the peer failed the whole time, even while the Mac was awake: the peer's ARP table had the Mac's IP at another MAC (`3a:fe:61:…`) — the sleep proxy (`dns-sd -B _sleep-proxy._udp` lists it) answers ARP for the sleeping Mac, and it answers no ICMP. Firewall stealth mode was off.

Settings on the sleeping Mac: `womp 1`, `sleep 0`, `tcpkeepalive 1`, `networkoversleep 0`. The Mac also DarkWakes by itself on stray Wi-Fi packets (one at +13 s with nobody sending), then sleeps again.

**해결:** Give the waker an ssh key restricted to one command on the sleeping Mac — `restrict,command="/usr/bin/caffeinate -u -t 2" ssh-ed25519 …` in `authorized_keys`. The waker loops every ~6 s: magic packet (UDP broadcast to the subnet and 255.255.255.255, ports 9 and 7), `nc -z -G3 <ip> 22`, then `ssh -i <that key>`. The ssh lands inside a DarkWake, `caffeinate -u` declares user activity, and the log shows `Wake from Deep Idle [CDNVA]` (V/A = display/audio = full wake). Measured: sleep at 02:46:48, wake command at 02:47:40, full wake at 02:47:43, ssh through the Mac's own Cloudflare tunnel 11 s after the command; still awake 100 s later (`sleep 0`). Test for "up" with ssh or a TCP banner, never ping. Use `sudo pmset schedule wake "<MM/dd/yy HH:mm:ss>"` as a fallback while testing; without sudo there is none. The waker must be awake on the same LAN — a server on another subnet cannot send the broadcast.

**재부팅 검증 (2026-10-13, 같은 날):** `osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to restart'` over ssh (no sudo) restarted the Mac. LAN ssh answered ~37 s after the trigger; the native cloudflared auto-started from its LaunchAgent ~40 s after boot with **no LuLu prompt** (the Always rule held), picked up the remote `ssh://localhost:22` ingress, and tunnel ssh was 6/6. Every other `com.mnori.*` LaunchAgent and the speakout colima VM came back on their own.

## OPS-433 — On macOS 27 a non-Apple binary started over ssh with `nohup … &` loses the LAN once the ssh session closes: `[Errno 65] No route to host`, while loopback and Apple binaries still connect

`측정 2026-10-13 · macOS 27.0.1 (MacBook Air M1) · uv cpython 3.11.16 · httpx 0.28.1 / websockets 17.2 · target on the same Wi-Fi LAN`

**증상:** A load generator launched with `ssh air 'nohup python loadgen.py … &'` failed every request to a LAN host (`192.168.0.x`) with `httpx.ConnectError: All connection attempts failed` and `OSError(65, 'No route to host')`. The same command run in the foreground of an ssh session worked, and `ping`/`curl` to the host worked at the same moment. Minimal check: a detached python that sleeps 8 s (so the ssh session has closed) and then connects gets `[Errno 65] No route to host` for the LAN address, `200` for `127.0.0.1`, and `200` from a `/usr/bin/curl` child it spawns. While the ssh session is still open, the detached process connects fine.

This is Local Network privacy: once the session ends, the process is no longer attributed to sshd, and a non-Apple binary without a Local Network grant is refused LAN addresses. Apple-signed binaries (`curl`, `ssh`) are exempt. It is not a firewall (LuLu) block: there is no prompt, loopback works, and the errno is 65 rather than a timeout.

**해결:** Keep the ssh session open for the whole run (run the remote command in the foreground and background the local `ssh` instead, with `-o ServerAliveInterval=15`), or reach the LAN host through an Apple binary, e.g. `ssh -L` to the target and connect to `127.0.0.1`. A LaunchAgent in the GUI session is attributed differently and needs its own Local Network grant.

## OPS-434 — Speech normalised by ffmpeg `loudnorm` to -1.5 dBTP measured +0.9 dBTP after encoding to mono AAC 64 kb/s; a sample-peak `alimiter` at 0.79 still left +0.6, 0.708 brought every file to ≤0.0 dBTP

`측정 2026-10-13 · ffmpeg (Homebrew, macOS 27) · loudnorm I=-16:TP=-1.5:LRA=11 two-pass linear=true · aac -b:a 64k -ac 1 -ar 44100 · 24 speech files of 5–134 s`

**증상:** After two-pass `loudnorm` with `TP=-1.5`, the encoded `.m4a` files measured -16.2…-16.6 LUFS as intended, but `ebur128=peak=true` gave a true peak of **+0.9 dBTP** on one story. Adding `alimiter=limit=0.79:level=false` (≈-2 dBFS) after `loudnorm` left **+0.6 dBTP** on another file. `alimiter` limits sample peaks; the AAC encoder at 64 kb/s adds the overshoot on top.

**해결:** Put `alimiter=limit=0.708:attack=5:release=50:level=false` (≈-3 dBFS) after `loudnorm` and measure the encoded file, not the filter output: then the highest of 24 files was 0.0 dBTP, and loudness stayed within -17.0…-16.4 LUFS. For a hard -1 dBTP ceiling, lower the limit further or encode at a higher bitrate and check again.

## OPS-435 — A tunnel CNAME re-pointed to a standby host kept the site answering 200 for 45 hours; only a request whose side effect lands on the intended origin shows which host serves it

`측정 2026-10-13 · Cloudflare DNS (proxied CNAME → <tunnel-id>.cfargotunnel.com) · two cloudflared tunnels, production on a Mac, standby Dokploy app on a Linux box · Speak Out`

**증상:** `speakout.mnori.com` was meant to be served by the Mac's tunnel. Its CNAME had been changed on 2026-10-12 08:15 UTC to another tunnel's `<id>.cfargotunnel.com`, where a standby copy of the same app runs (it builds on every push). Health checks, `/api/health` and page loads all returned 200 with the newest commit's settings, and the Mac's own tunnel showed four registered connections, so nothing looked wrong. The standby has no language model, so for 45 hours every public call got scripted replies (0.25 s, text identical to the mission file) and every report fell back to the basic one.

How it was found: a `POST /api/review/prefetch` through the public URL did not warm the cache of the Mac's process, a public turn added no task to the model server's log, and `dig` only shows Cloudflare's proxy IPs. The tunnel id is in the connector's `TUNNEL_TOKEN` (base64 JSON, field `t`); compare it with the CNAME target from `GET /zones/<zone>/dns_records?name=<host>`.

**해결:** After any deploy, check the serving origin with a request only that origin can answer (a cache it fills, a log line on a backend only it reaches), not with a health route both copies share. When two copies of a site exist, record which tunnel id the CNAME should point to, and fix a drift with `PATCH /zones/<zone>/dns_records/<id> {"content":"<tunnel-id>.cfargotunnel.com","proxied":true}` (a DNS-edit API token is enough; the change took effect within 20 s).

## OPS-436 — Projection un-blending (OPS-388) cuts a seam inside ink outlines on white or light cloth; Vision's foreground mask drops tinted folds of white cloth; tall hair and hats still touch the top edge

`측정 2026-10-14 · codex-cli 0.162.0 image generation (1024x1536, 11 generations) · macOS Vision VNGenerateForegroundInstanceMaskRequest · Pillow + numpy + scipy`

**증상:**
1. With the OPS-388 edge method (alpha from projecting each edge pixel onto the line from the background grey to the outline ink), the anti-aliased pixels on the **inner** side of the outline lost their alpha: a pixel blending black ink (40) with white cloth (208) reads 145, which on grey channels is also a blend of ink with the grey (181). A chef's toque and jacket came out with 544 small enclosed holes along the outline (counted as alpha ≤ 128 inside the filled silhouette). A global flood fill "from the background, not through ink" does not fix it: it leaks through any gap in the outline and reaches the whole figure.
2. Ink pixels themselves blocked that flood, so the outline's own outer anti-aliased pixel (lum ~100, half ink, half grey) stayed at full alpha and showed as a light dotted fringe on dark UI.
3. On a white bedsheet costume, Vision's foreground mask set an enclosed pale-blue shaded fold (RGB 157,158,172 on a 160,159,160 background) to background: an 800-px hole. A plain colour key (RGB distance < 16) also took it for the grey.
4. The shared portrait prompt's "the top of the head (including any hat) sits a little below the top edge" still let a hair updo be cut by the top edge (53 mask pixels on row 0) and a paper-bag hat touch it, in 2 of 8 first generations.

**해결:**
1. Give the measured alpha only to pixels the background reaches in a few 4-connected steps (4 worked) without crossing ink (lum more than 60 below the grey), plus one step into the ink for the outline's outer pixel. Everything else on the edge band stays solid. Holes along the outline: 544 → 21 (chef), 189 → 0 (robot), 0-20 on the other six. The few remaining are real background pockets.
2. Fill the enclosed holes of the Vision mask whose pixels are mostly not "keyable". Count a pixel as background only if its RGB distance to the grey is < 16 **and** its saturation (max − min) is within 6 of the grey's. The tinted shading fails the second test.
3. Put the headroom into the character paragraph as a visible gap: "the whole updo inside the image with a clear strip of light-grey background between the top of her hair and the top edge". The regenerations put the top at row 12 and row 33.
4. Pale steam or glow drawn lighter than the grey disappears with any key. Keep it inside a box as translucent white, alpha = (lum − grey lum − 3) / (255 − grey lum) × 1.5.
5. A "bedsheet ghost costume pushed back off the face" was drawn over a bare chest. Name the clothes under any costume, cape or open coat when the brief asks for modest clothing.

## OPS-437 — Firebase sign-in setup without the console: authorized domains, an Android app with its SHA-1s (which creates the Android OAuth clients) and the web client ID, all from the Admin SDK service account

`측정 2026-10-14 · Firebase project mnori1 · Identity Toolkit admin v2, Firebase Management API v1beta1 · service account firebase-adminsdk-fbsvc@…`

**증상:** a new `*.mnori.com` game and its Android app needed Google sign-in on the shared project. The usual route is three console screens (Authentication → Settings → Authorized domains, Project settings → Add app → SHA-1, Google Cloud → Credentials for the web client ID). The project's Admin SDK service account (the one a hub keeps in `FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT`) is allowed to do all three by REST; a token from it with scope `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/cloud-platform` is enough.

- Authorized domains: `GET https://identitytoolkit.googleapis.com/admin/v2/projects/<id>/config`, append to `authorizedDomains`, `PATCH …/config?updateMask=authorizedDomains` with the whole list. Took effect at once (`GET https://identitytoolkit.googleapis.com/v1/projects?key=<web api key>` lists the domains without any credential). Careful: that `GET …/config` also returns `signIn.hashConfig.signerKey`; do not print the whole body into a log.
- Web client ID (the `serverClientId` Credential Manager needs on Android): `GET …/admin/v2/projects/<id>/defaultSupportedIdpConfigs/google.com` → `clientId`.
- Android app: `POST https://firebase.googleapis.com/v1beta1/projects/<id>/androidApps {"packageName":…}` returns an operation; the app is listed seconds later. Then `POST …/androidApps/<appId>/sha {"shaHash":"<40 hex>","certType":"SHA_1"}` once per certificate. Each SHA-1 got its own Android OAuth client (client_type 1) in `GET …/androidApps/<appId>/config` (base64 google-services.json) within 20 s; no Cloud console step.
- Play's app-signing SHA-1 without opening Play Console: `apksigner verify --print-certs` on a Play-signed universal APK (App bundle explorer download); the upload key's from `keytool -list -v`.

**해결:** keep a small script that mints the service-account token (JWT bearer grant) and calls these endpoints; read the service account out of the running hub container's environment into a 0600 file rather than copying it into a repo. A WebView app that signs in natively hands the Google ID token to Firebase JS with `signInWithCredential(GoogleAuthProvider.credential(idToken))`; that call is accepted from the `https://appassets.androidplatform.net` origin, which is not an authorized domain (measured 2026-10-14 on a Pixel 7 Pro: Credential Manager account chooser → ID token → `signInWithCredential` → signed in, and the ID token then verified on the game server; the project's web API key had no referrer restriction). A debug build with an `applicationIdSuffix` needs its own Firebase Android app with the debug keystore's SHA-1, or the chooser never returns a credential.

## OPS-438 — Godot on the Air's Metal: `ERROR: timeout waiting for fence` appears in a windowed run after the host has been up for hours, in code that passed earlier the same day

`측정 2026-10-14 · Godot 4.7.2.stable · Metal 4.0 Forward+ · MacBook Air M1 (MacBookAir10,1) · uptime 16 h 50 min`

**증상:** a windowed Godot gate that treats any `^ERROR:` line as a failure fails with
`ERROR: timeout waiting for fence` at `drivers/metal/rendering_device_driver_metal3.cpp:54`, raised while the scene builds text meshes (`TextMesh`/glyph generation). The process still exits 0.
The same gate passed on the same tree about an hour earlier. A separate isolated copy of the previous, already-pushed commit failed the same way minutes later, so the change under test was not the cause. No other Godot or browser process was running on the Air.

It cleared on its own: 75 minutes later, with no restart (uptime 18 h 11 min), the same gate passed 8 of 8 windowed runs.

**해결:** before debugging your own change, run the same gate on the last known-good commit in a second isolated copy. If that fails too, the host's GPU state is the cause: keep the evidence (both logs) and retry an hour later; it does not need a restart. Do not loosen the gate's `^ERROR:` match to get past it.

## OPS-439 — Timing a PWA's install-to-open hand-off on Android over adb: the opened app shows as Chrome's `SameTaskWebApkActivity`, not as the WebAPK package

`측정 2026-10-14 · Pixel 7 Pro (Android 17) · Chrome 154.0.8037.127 · adb 1.0.41`

**증상:** a loop waiting for the freshly installed app with `dumpsys activity activities | grep topResumedActivity | grep -q webapk` never stopped, although the app was on screen. While a WebAPK runs, `topResumedActivity` names `com.android.chrome/org.chromium.chrome.browser.webapps.SameTaskWebApkActivity` (capital A, k): the `org.chromium.webapk.*` package appears only in `dumpsys activity recents` as the task's `baseIntent` (`cmp=org.chromium.webapk.<hash>_v2/...SplashActivity`, `dat=` the start URL). `adb shell pm list packages` lines end in `\r`, so `dumpsys package $p` with an unstripped name finds nothing and the new WebAPK looks missing.

Measured with the OPS-284 hand-off (poll `getInstalledRelatedApps()`, +3 s, `intent://…?open-app=1`) on a fresh install (`adb uninstall` of the old WebAPK, no data dialog this time): `beforeinstallprompt` was already there when the page loaded, and the app was in front **11.3 s** after tapping 「설치」 in Chrome's sheet (`firstInstallTime` of the new WebAPK fell inside that window). Earlier runs: 8.1–10.8 s (OPS-284, OPS-324), so tell users "about 10 s", not "within 10 s".

**해결:** match case-insensitively (`grep -qi webapk`) or on `SameTaskWebApkActivity`; strip `\r` (`tr -d '\r'`) before using package names from `pm list packages`. On a phone shared with other sessions, read `topResumedActivity` before every `input tap`: another session may bring its own app to the front mid-run (AGT-044).

## OPS-440 — Play Console Data safety by CSV import (Playwright): headed Brave never finishes the upload, a second confirm dialog follows "가져오기", and "저장" stays disabled until the target audience and the privacy policy URL exist

`측정 2026-10-14 · Play Console (ko) · Brave 1.97 via playwright-core, persistent profile copy · app in internal testing only`

**증상:** filling Data safety by hand is five screens; the page has "CSV 파일로 내보내기 / CSV에서 가져오기". Exporting gives every question as `Question ID, Response ID, Response value, Answer requirement, label` rows (782 rows, values empty for an app that never filled the form). Importing hit four snags:

- In **headed** Brave the file sat at "ds-after.csv 업로드 중" for minutes and then failed with "업로드할 수 없습니다. 다시 시도해 보세요." The same file uploaded at once **headless**. (An App Bundle upload in headed Brave on the same machine also crawled at 1 MB in 3.5 min on the first try.)
- A rejected answer is reported in the dialog by question ID, e.g. `PSL_HAS_OUTSIDE_APP_ACCOUNTS에 답변할 수 없습니다.` — leave that row's value empty.
- After clicking "가져오기" a second dialog opens ("CSV에서 가져오시겠습니까? … 덮어쓰기됩니다", buttons 취소/가져오기); the first dialog stays in the DOM, so click "가져오기" in the **last** `[role=dialog]`.
- On step 5 the "저장" button is disabled while the app has no target-audience/content declaration or privacy policy URL; "임시보관함에 저장" works and keeps the answers.

Values that imported: `true`/`false` in the value column for yes/no and multiple-choice rows (`PSL_DATA_TYPES_PERSONAL,PSL_EMAIL,true`; `PSL_DATA_USAGE_RESPONSES:PSL_EMAIL:PSL_DATA_USAGE_EPHEMERAL,,false`), and the URL text for `PSL_ACCOUNT_DELETION_URL` / `PSL_DATA_DELETION_URL`.

**해결:** export → edit the value column with a script → import headless → confirm in the last dialog → press "다음" (`getByRole('button', {name: '다음', exact: true})`) to step 5 → "저장" or, until the prerequisites exist, "임시보관함에 저장". The privacy policy URL is its own page (`app-content/privacy-policy`, one text input and "저장").

## OPS-441 — Portrait cut-outs: clearing "enclosed grey pockets" (OPS-388) also deletes pale parts of the figure; a hidden-object gag ("bulging sleeve") is not drawn until a visible piece of the object is named

`측정 2026-10-14 · codex-cli 0.162.0 image generation (1024x1536, 9 generations) · macOS Vision VNGenerateForegroundInstanceMaskRequest · Pillow + numpy + scipy`

**증상:**
1. The OPS-388 step that turns flat grey patches enclosed by the figure into background (component ≥ 30 px, mean within 6 RGB of the grey, saturation ≤ 8) also removed real figure parts in 4 of 7 portraits: a grey-shaded fold of a white undershirt (287 px), the pale frayed threads at a denim vest's armholes (3088 px in all), a pale blue-grey patch of a paper map, and two pale shirt buttons. On dark UI each shows as a hole; on a magenta check it is obvious.
2. Vision's foreground mask left a 360-px hole in the faintly blue shading of a white paper cap (RGB 189,192,194 on a 187,187,187 grey). It passes the OPS-436 "keyable" test (distance < 16, saturation within 6), so the hole-refill step leaves it open.
3. A brief of "one sleeve suspiciously bulging" (and, on retry, "an obvious, comically large round bulge, clearly the shape of a hidden cup") came back as an ordinary smooth sleeve twice.
4. The headroom sentence of OPS-436 in every character paragraph ("a clear strip of light-grey background between the top of the cap and the top edge") held in 9 of 9 generations: top of the head at rows 17-63.

**해결:**
1. Run pocket clearing only on figures with hair spikes, strands or wires, and list every enclosed hole afterwards (alpha ≤ 128 inside the hole-filled silhouette, with its bounding box), then compare each box with the raw image. Holes between an arm and the body are real; holes on cloth, buttons or props mean: cut again without pocket clearing.
2. Fill such a mask hole by hand: fill enclosed holes of the thresholded mask (`binary_fill_holes(m > 128) & ~(m > 128)`) only inside a box around the hole, save the mask, and cut again.
3. Name a visible piece of the hidden thing: "a big round lump swells the cloth halfway up the forearm, and the red rim of a fourth hidden cup peeks out of that sleeve's cuff" drew both on the third generation.

## OPS-442 — GitLab push webhook silently not sent for some pushes; check `hooks/:id/events`, re-fire with the test endpoint

`측정 2026-10-14 · gitlab.com (during its announced 15:00–19:00 UTC rate-limit preview window), Dokploy deploy webhook`

**증상:** `git push origin main` succeeded and the project's events API listed the pushes
(`pushed to d8c6b51a`, `pushed to f6bcb615` at 15:01 UTC), but Dokploy never deployed: the hook's
delivery log had **no entry at all** for either push — not a failed delivery, nothing — while the
previous deliveries (10/10) were all `200 Application deployed successfully`. A later push at
15:15 was delivered 58 s after it. The site kept serving a 2-day-old build with no error anywhere.

Check it from the API, not the site: `glab api projects/<ns>%2F<repo>/hooks` for the hook id,
then `glab api "projects/<ns>%2F<repo>/hooks/<id>/events?per_page=6"` — each delivery shows its
time, response status, response body and the `after` commit. A push with no row there was never
sent.

**해결:** re-fire the hook for the branch head: `glab api -X POST
"projects/<ns>%2F<repo>/hooks/<id>/test/push_events"` (returns `201 Created`, the delivery appears
in the events list, and Dokploy deploys the latest commit). After any push-to-deploy, confirm the
served build changed (a string only the new build has, or `last-modified`) rather than assuming it.

## OPS-443 — CSS `color-mix()`의 두 비율 합이 100%보다 작으면 결과 색이 반투명해진다. 원 버튼 뒤의 선이 비쳐 보인다

`측정 2026-10-14 · Brave 1.96(Chromium 154)`

**증상:** `radial-gradient(color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 70%, #fff 6%), …)`로 칠한 불투명해야 할 원 버튼 위로, 뒤에 그린 SVG 경로 선이 비쳐 보였다. z-index와 쌓임 맥락을 먼저 의심했지만 원인이 아니었다.

명세상 두 비율의 합이 100% 미만이면 섞은 색에 그 합만큼의 알파가 곱해진다(70% + 6% → 알파 0.76). 합이 100%를 넘으면 정규화될 뿐 알파는 1이다.

**해결:** 비율을 하나만 적거나(`color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 88%, #fff)`) 합을 100%로 맞춘다. 반투명이 의도가 아니면 `color-mix`의 두 번째 비율을 쓰지 않는다.

## OPS-444 — Android WebView app: a web page can own the system Back button with `history.pushState`, because the activity's `canGoBack()` counts same-document entries

`측정 2026-10-14 · androidx.webkit 1.14 (WebViewAssetLoader, https://appassets.androidplatform.net origin) · Android 15 emulator (API 35, arm64) · MainActivity.onBackPressed = if (webView.canGoBack()) goBack() else super`

**증상:** a WebView game wanted Back to go from its game screen to its own title screen and only then leave the app, without changing the Kotlin code and shipping a new native handler. With the usual `onBackPressed` (`canGoBack() ? goBack() : finish`), Back on the page's only entry closed the app.

A same-document `history.pushState({...}, '')` made by the page (on leaving its title screen) is a back-forward list entry for the WebView: the next Back made `canGoBack()` true, `goBack()` fired `popstate` in the page, and the page put its title screen back. A second Back on the title (no entry left) closed the app as before. Re-pushing an entry inside the `popstate` handler made Back do nothing on screens that must not be left by Back (an active call) — measured: Back during the call left the activity resumed and the call on screen, ending the call and pressing Back showed the title, Back again returned to the launcher.

**해결:** give the page one pushed entry above its root screen and handle `popstate` in JS; no native change is needed for a "Back returns to the title, then exits" flow. Track whether this page load pushed the entry (a flag, not `history.state`, which survives reloads): calling `history.back()` to return to the root when nothing was pushed leaves the site.

## OPS-445 — `codex exec` research run: the model listed sources it never opened in this run, even when told only opened pages count; check the `web_search` record, not the answer

> **무효 (2026-10-16):** the diagnosis below is most likely wrong. Codex records a page such as `quran.com/36:14/…` as `quran.com/36%3A14/…`, and the runner compared exact strings, so pages the run did open looked unopened. See OPS-446. The advice to check the record still holds; compare URLs in a canonical form.

`측정 2026-10-16 · codex-cli 0.162.0 · GPT-6-Astra on a ChatGPT login · one 12-minute research-and-write run with `--json`, 19 sources in the answer`

**증상:** a draft built from `codex exec --json` web research cited two pages (quran.com tafsir URLs) that appear nowhere in the run's events: no `web_search` item had them as a search hit or an opened page. The other 17 sources were all in the record. The prompt already said that only pages opened in this run count as read and that search snippets do not.

The addresses were well-formed and plausible, so the answer alone gives no sign they were written from memory. The events are the only evidence: every search and every page open is an `item.completed` of type `web_search`, and an opened page carries a `view…` reference (see the `-c web_search` entry above for the event shape).

**해결:** compare each URL in the answer against the URLs in the `web_search` events before using it, and treat a missing one as unread (drop it with the sentences that rest on it, or ask again), never as a parsing gap. Name the failure mode in the prompt as well ("an address known from memory is not a source unless you open it in this run"); it lowers the rate but does not replace the check.

## OPS-446 — `codex exec --json` `web_search` records percent-encode `:` in a URL path: `quran.com/36:14/…` comes back as `quran.com/36%3A14/…`, so an exact-string check calls a page you opened "never opened"

`측정 2026-10-16 · codex-cli 0.162.0 · GPT-6-Astra and Sonnet (Claude Code WebFetch) · 2 runs each opening https://quran.com/36:14/tafsirs/en-tafisr-ibn-kathir and …/36:29/…`

**증상:** a provenance gate that compares the URLs in a model's answer with the URLs in the run's tool record refused two sources as "not in the record / never read". The model's answer wrote `https://quran.com/36:14/…`; Codex's `item.completed` `web_search` results for the page it opened (a `view…` ref) carried `https://quran.com/36%3A14/…`, in both runs. Claude Code's WebFetch tool record kept the `:` as given. `new URL()` does not unify the two: `%3A` and `:` stay different in `href`.

A filter that keeps only record URLs equal to an answer URL also throws the encoded entries away, so the saved record no longer shows that the page was opened, and the failure looks like the model citing from memory (see OPS-445, now marked invalid).

**해결:** compare in a canonical form: parse with `new URL()`, drop the fragment and the trailing slash, and decode percent-escapes of characters a path may carry literally (`%3A %40 %2C %21 %24 %26 %27 %28 %29 %2A %2B %3B %3D`), but never `%2F`. Keep the answer's spelling when you pass the record on, so a later exact-string check on the server still matches. Keep the raw tool transcript of a refused run until someone has looked at it; without it the two causes cannot be told apart.

## OPS-447 — wrangler's OAuth login died (refresh failed) and the Air's Google profile wanted a passkey: a headed browser on the main Mac with a copy of the gstack profile, placed off-screen, approved it in one pass

`측정 2026-10-16 · wrangler 4.135.0 · Chrome for Testing (ms-playwright chromium-1243) · Brave 1.96 on the Air`

**증상:** every wrangler command answered `Not logged in. Your auth token has expired and could not be refreshed, and the environment is non-interactive`; `npx wrangler auth token` (OPS-293) could not refresh either. `~/.config/cloudflare/token` is a narrow API token (zones only): Workers, Workers AI, D1, Turnstile and the domains API all answered `Authentication error` (10000).

- `wrangler login --browser=false` prints the consent URL and listens on `localhost:8976` for about two minutes, then exits 1.
- On the Air (`ssh -N -R 8976:localhost:8976 air` forwards the callback to the Mac), the Cloudflare login page offered the Google account, but Google stopped at `accounts.google.com/v3/signin/challenge/pk` (passkey) in `~/kc-test/profile` and in copies of the other `~/kc-test/profile-*` (their `.dash.cloudflare.com vses2` cookie no longer held a session).
- Headless Chrome for Testing on the Mac stopped at Cloudflare's own check ("잠시만 기다리십시오…") on `dash.cloudflare.com/login` and never got further.

**해결:** on the main Mac, copy `~/.gstack/chromium-profile` to a scratch directory, start `npx wrangler login --browser=false` in the background, read the URL from its output, and open it with Playwright `launchPersistentContext(copy, { executablePath: <Chrome for Testing>, headless: false, ignoreDefaultArgs: ['--enable-automation'], args: ['--disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled', '--window-position=-2400,-2400'] })`. The off-screen position kept the window out of the owner's way. Click `chowooick@gmail.com` on the Cloudflare login page, then the consent page's Allow; the page lands on `welcome.developers.workers.dev/wrangler-oauth-consent-granted` and wrangler prints `Successfully logged in.` within a minute. Delete the profile copy afterwards. Same idea as OPS-396's dashboard session.

## OPS-448 — A Workers custom domain moved to another Worker by deploying that Worker with the same `custom_domain` route; no prompt, no DNS change

`측정 2026-10-16 · wrangler 4.135.0 OAuth · Workers Free`

**증상:** kyominnews.com was a custom domain of the Worker `kyomincenter` (`{ "pattern": "kyominnews.com", "custom_domain": true }`). A new Worker needed it.

`wrangler deploy` of the new Worker with the same route entry, run non-interactively, printed `Deployed kyominnews triggers … kyominnews.com (custom domain)` and the domain answered from the new Worker at once (first request about 5 s later). There was no confirmation prompt and no error like OPS-093's 100117, because the hostname's DNS record was Worker-managed, not external.

**해결:** deploy the new Worker first, then remove the route from the old Worker's config before its next deploy, or that deploy takes the domain back.

## OPS-449 — Astro dev on @astrojs/cloudflare: a middleware that stores pages in `caches.default` keeps serving the old page after an edit, even across dev-server restarts

`측정 2026-10-16 · astro 7.3.3 · @astrojs/cloudflare 14.3.2 · workerd 1.20260918`

**증상:** after editing a component, `curl` of the page returned the old markup in 15 ms, also after killing and restarting `astro dev`. The middleware answered GETs from `caches.default` and put every public 200 there; the dev runtime's cache is real and persists in `.wrangler/state`.

**해결:** skip the Cache API while developing: `const cacheable = !import.meta.env.DEV && …`.

## OPS-450 — npm on the Air skips esbuild's and workerd's postinstall ("not yet covered by allowScripts"); approve and rebuild before `astro dev`

`측정 2026-10-16 · npm on the Air (install-scripts gating) · esbuild 0.28 · workerd 1.2026`

**증상:** `npm install` ended with `npm warn install-scripts … esbuild@0.28.2 (postinstall: node install.js) … workerd@… (postinstall …)` and `Run npm install-scripts approve <pkg> to allow`. The packages are installed without their platform binaries.

**해결:** `npm install-scripts approve esbuild workerd` (add `fsevents` on macOS), then `npm rebuild esbuild workerd`. `approve` writes an allow list into `package.json`; in a shared repository restore that file afterwards if the change is not meant to be committed.

## OPS-451 — Email Routing set up in four REST calls with the wrangler OAuth token; `~/.config/cloudflare/token` cannot, and port 25 from the Air times out

`측정 2026-10-17 · wrangler OAuth token (scope `email_routing (write)`) · Cloudflare free zone with no MX · Air on the home line`

**증상:** `~/.config/cloudflare/token` reads `GET /zones/:id/email/routing` (200) but answers `10000 Authentication error` on `…/email/routing/rules` and `/accounts/:acct/email/routing/addresses`. The dashboard-session route answered 403 on the writes (OPS-396).

The wrangler OAuth token had expired; one `npx wrangler whoami` refreshed it (OPS-289). With `Authorization: Bearer <oauth_token>` from `default.toml`:

1. `GET /accounts/:acct/email/routing/addresses` — the destination verified for another zone is listed `status: verified`; no new verification mail.
2. `POST /zones/:id/email/routing/enable {}` — returned `enabled: true, status: ready` and added **all five** records (MX ×3, DKIM `cf2024-1._domainkey`, SPF), not only MX and SPF as OPS-339 says. `synced` went from false to true within about 2 minutes. Public resolvers (1.1.1.1, 8.8.8.8) answered the MX at once.
3. `POST /zones/:id/email/routing/rules` with `{"enabled":true,"matchers":[{"type":"literal","field":"to","value":"hello@<zone>"}],"actions":[{"type":"forward","value":["<verified address>"]}]}` — 200, priority 0. The catch-all stays `drop`, disabled (OPS-100).

The same OAuth token cannot list DNS records (`result: null`, its `zone:read` has no DNS scope); read them with the narrow token.

The SMTP RCPT check of OPS-396 does not work from the Air: `smtplib.SMTP("route1.mx.cloudflare.net", 25)` timed out (outbound 25 blocked on that line). The Gmail end-to-end send from `~/kc-test/profile` stopped at the passkey challenge (OPS-447).

**해결:** for Email Routing by API, run `npx wrangler whoami` first and use the OAuth token; skip the narrow token. Verify with `GET …/email/routing` (`enabled`, `status: ready`, `synced: true`), `GET …/email/routing/rules` and `dig MX`. Do not plan on port 25 from the Air.

## OPS-452 — Email Routing end to end from the Air: Gmail drops a compose-URL send if the page leaves within seconds; read the activity log with GraphQL `emailRoutingAdaptive`

`측정 2026-10-17 · Gmail web (ko UI) · Brave 1.96 on the Air, `~/kc-test/profile` · Cloudflare GraphQL Analytics API with the wrangler OAuth token`

**증상:**
- A script opened `mail.google.com/mail/u/0/?view=cm&fs=1&to=…&su=…&body=…`, clicked `[role=button][aria-label^="보내기"]`, waited 7 s and opened the next compose URL. Four sends "succeeded" and none reached `#sent` or Cloudflare. Gmail's undo-send window was still open when the page navigated away.
- The toast text `메일을 보냈습니다` never matched `body.innerText`, even for sends that went through. Do not use it as the check.
- Polling the GraphQL API every 20 s for two zones hit `Rate limiter budget depleted. Please try again after 5 minutes` (code `budget`) within about 7 minutes.
- `osascript` over ssh to Safari on the Air answered `AppleEvent 시간이 초과되었습니다 (-1712)`; a Gmail session in Safari is no use to a script.
- 「필터 가져오기」 (XML, OPS-102) → 「필터 만들기」 showed the toast 「필터 가져오기가 완료되었습니다」 and listed the new filters, but **nothing was saved**: after a reload they were gone. The first POST of that click was `mail/u/0/reauthchallenge`, answered with a challenge token, and no re-auth dialog appeared. Twice, about 20 minutes and about 3.5 hours after a passkey sign-in. The search-panel path (`#create-filter/to=@domain` → 「필터 만들기」 → tick 「다음 라벨 적용」 + 「새 라벨...」 + 「절대 스팸으로 신고하지 않음」 + 「일치하는 대화 N개에도 필터 적용」 → 「필터 만들기」) saved at once with no re-auth, toast 「필터를 만들었습니다」, and labelled the existing mail.

**해결:**
- After clicking 보내기, wait at least 20 s before navigating, then check `#sent` for the subject.
- Read the routing result without the dashboard: `POST /client/v4/graphql` with `{ viewer { zones(filter:{zoneTag:"<id>"}) { emailRoutingAdaptive(limit:10, filter:{datetime_geq:"<ISO>"}, orderBy:[datetime_DESC]) { datetime from to status action spf dkim dmarc } } } }`. A forwarded mail shows `status: delivered, action: forward`. Rows appeared about 1 minute after sending. Query once after 3 to 5 minutes (OPS-098) instead of polling. The narrow `~/.config/cloudflare/token` lacks `zone.analytics.read`.
- Create the per-domain Gmail filters (OPS-099) through the search panel, not XML import, and check them after a full reload. Open `#create-filter/to=…` in a fresh page load for each filter: a second hash change in the same page did not open the panel.

## OPS-453 — Playwright `fullPage` screenshot of a page taller than 16,384 px: past that line the PNG starts the page over from the top, with no error

`측정 2026-10-17 · playwright-core (~/kc-test on the Air) · Brave 1.96 headless · 1440 × 1000 viewport, deviceScaleFactor 1`

**증상:** a long single-page document (scrollHeight 19,487 px at 1440 wide, 28,620 px at 390 wide) was captured with `page.screenshot({ fullPage: true })`. The PNG had the full height, and everything up to about y = 16,384 was right. Below that, the image showed the page's first screen again (header, hero) instead of the last chapters. No warning, no error, exit 0. It looks like the page itself repeats its top, which sends you hunting for a layout bug that is not there.

16,384 px is Chromium's maximum texture size; the capture is not split into tiles beyond it.

**해결:** do not judge anything below 16,384 px from a `fullPage` capture. Scroll and capture viewport-sized pieces (`window.scrollTo(0, y)` then `page.screenshot()`), or capture the element you care about with `locator.screenshot()`. For overflow checks, measure `document.documentElement.scrollWidth` instead of looking.

## OPS-454 — `wrangler deploy` of a Workflow Worker can fail once with `Authentication error [code: 10000]` on `/workflows/<name>`; the same command a minute later deploys

`측정 2026-10-17 · wrangler 4.135.0, OAuth login (Super Administrator) · Workers Free · a Worker with one `workflows` binding`

**증상:** `npx wrangler deploy --config engine/wrangler.jsonc` printed only the token's scope list and the account roles, then exited. Nothing on stdout said it failed. The log in `~/Library/Preferences/.wrangler/logs/` held `A request to the Cloudflare API (/accounts/<id>/workflows/<workflow name>) failed. Authentication error [code: 10000]`. The scope list printed by `wrangler whoami` has no line naming workflows, which makes it look like a missing permission.

**해결:** run the same deploy again; the second run printed `Uploaded …`, `Deployed … triggers` with `workflow: <name>` and a new version id. This is the same one-off failure as OPS-202 (`d1 create`). Check for `Current Version ID` in the output before calling a deploy done, read the log when it is missing, and do not re-login or rotate tokens over one 10000.

## OPS-455 — Census Reporter API reads ACS by ZIP code with geo id `86000US<ZIP>`; median gross rent is top-coded at 3501

`측정 2026-10-17 · api.censusreporter.org/1.0 · ACS 2020–2024 5-year (acs2024_5yr) · tables B25064, B25031`

**증상:** ZIP 단위 렌트가 필요한데 api.census.gov는 키 없이 302를 돌려준다(OPS-372). OPS-372의 geo id 목록에는 메트로·카운티·주만 있어 ZIP을 어떻게 넣는지 알 수 없다. 받아 보면 일부 ZIP의 중위 월세가 정확히 `3501`이고 오차(`error`)가 `null`이다.

ZIP(정확히는 ZCTA)은 `86000US` 접두사로 읽힌다. 16개를 한 요청에 쉼표로 묶어도 된다:
`https://api.censusreporter.org/1.0/data/show/latest?table_ids=B25064,B25031&geo_ids=86000US07024,86000US07650`
값은 `data["86000US07024"]["B25064"].estimate["B25064001"]`(중위 총월세, 유틸 포함), 2베드는 `B25031004`, 오차는 같은 자리의 `error`. 표 4개를 한 번에 요청했더니 응답이 오지 않아 `curl -o`가 파일을 만들지 못했다. 표 2개씩 나누니 곧바로 왔다.

`3501`은 실제 값이 아니라 ACS 상한값(top-code)이다. "3,500달러 이상"으로 표시해야 하며, 이때는 오차가 `null`로 온다. 작은 ZIP은 오차가 크다(예: 07626 중위 2,599 ± 1,033). 오차/값이 0.2를 넘으면 "표본 적음"으로 표시하는 것이 안전하다. 5년 평균이라 현재 호가보다 낮다.

**해결:** geo id를 `86000US<5자리 ZIP>`로 쓰고, 표는 2개씩 나눠 요청한다. `3501`은 "3,500+"로 바꾸고, 오차가 큰 값에는 표시를 붙인다.

## OPS-456 — Workers Free with all five cron triggers taken: a SQLite Durable Object that sets its own alarm every hour is the clock

`측정 2026-10-17 · Cloudflare Workers Free · wrangler 4.135.0 · Durable Objects with `new_sqlite_classes` · compatibility_date 2026-09-18`

**증상:** a new job (a 7 a.m. web-push alert) needed an hourly schedule, but the account's five cron triggers were all in use; a sixth `triggers.crons` entry cannot be added on the free plan.

**해결:** one Durable Object instance (`idFromName('hub')`) on the free plan's SQLite backend does the scheduling:
- wrangler: `"durable_objects": { "bindings": [{ "name": "HUB", "class_name": "PushHub" }] }` and `"migrations": [{ "tag": "v1", "new_sqlite_classes": ["PushHub"] }]`. Deploy needs no cron and no route; other Workers reach it through a service binding.
- In every `fetch` of the object, `if (await ctx.storage.getAlarm() === null) await ctx.storage.setAlarm(nextTopOfHour + 5000)`, so the first request after a deploy starts the clock.
- `alarm()` does the hour's work, then `setAlarm()` for the next hour, or for `Date.now() + 2000` when it stopped early to stay under the 50-subrequest limit (OPS-263): an alarm is its own invocation with its own budget.
- Measured: the alarm set at 14:4x for 15:00:05 UTC ran, and `getAlarm()` read 16:00:05 UTC at 15:00:35.
- Keep "done today" state in the object's SQLite (`ctx.storage.sql.exec`), not in memory: an object can be evicted between alarms.

## OPS-457 — An `ai` binding in wrangler.jsonc stops `astro dev` (@astrojs/cloudflare 14) in a non-interactive shell; `remoteBindings: false` keeps local dev working
`측정 2026-10-17 · astro 7.3.3 · @astrojs/cloudflare 14.3 (vite plugin) · wrangler 4.125 · Workers AI`

**증상:** after adding `"ai": { "binding": "..." }` to wrangler.jsonc, `astro dev` over ssh logs `Failed to start the remote proxy session. Error reloading remote server: In a non-interactive environment, it's necessary to set a CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN environment variable` and every page answers `404: Not Found (trailingSlash is set to "always")`, so a whole Playwright suite fails at the first `goto`. Workers AI exists only remotely, so the Cloudflare vite plugin opens a remote proxy session for it, which needs an API token the test machine does not have.

**해결:** `adapter: cloudflare({ remoteBindings: process.env.KC_REMOTE_BINDINGS === '1' })` in astro.config.mjs. Local dev starts again (wrangler only warns that AI bindings always access remote resources); the binding is simply absent there, so mock the endpoint that uses it (`page.route`). Deploys are unaffected. Name the binding something other than `AI` if other code switches behaviour on `env.AI` being present.

Model choice for Korean form-filling (JSON fields from a short Korean note, and from a photo of a printed Korean flyer), same prompt, Workers AI REST: `@cf/mistralai/mistral-small-3.1-24b-instruct` 5.6-8.8 s with every field right and image input; `@cf/openai/gpt-oss-120b` 29.5 s; `@cf/qwen/qwen3.8-27b` 54.8 s. Mistral wraps JSON in a ```json fence when `response_format` is not set, and returns `result.response` as an object for image input. In production through the binding it took 8.4 s (text) and 8.6 s (image).

## OPS-458 — 개발 맥에서 Workers AI REST로 돌린 실측도 같은 계정의 하루 무료 뉴런을 쓴다: 실측 직후 운영 Worker의 같은 모델 호출이 4006으로 바로 실패했다

`측정 2026-10-17 · Workers AI REST(wrangler 로그인 토큰)와 Worker 바인딩, Workers Free 플랜, @cf/mistralai/mistral-small-3.1-24b-instruct(사진 입력)`

**증상:** 새 기능(사진 한 장 → 중고 판매글 초안)의 모델을 고르려고 개발 맥에서 REST로 사진 22장을 두 번(44회) 돌렸다. 몇 시간 뒤 운영에 배포하자 같은 모델을 부르는 엔드포인트가 0.3초 만에 502를 냈다. 같은 사이트의 다른 Workers AI 기능들도 이미 4006(`used up your daily free allocation`)으로 막혀 있었다.

- 하루 10,000뉴런(OPS-116)은 계정 단위다. REST 실측, `wrangler dev --remote`, 운영 바인딩, 다른 Worker(수집기 번역 등)가 모두 같은 한도를 나눠 쓴다. 사진 입력은 텍스트보다 뉴런이 크다.
- 실패는 즉시 오고(수백 ms) 메시지도 모델 오류처럼 보여서, 프롬프트나 입력 형식 문제로 착각하기 쉽다.

**해결:** 무료 플랜 계정에서 모델 실측은 `result.usage.neurons`를 합산해 기록하고, 운영 기능이 쓸 몫을 남긴다(OPS-354의 GraphQL로 하루 사용량 확인). 운영 기능은 한 모델에만 기대지 말고 순서대로 대체하게 둔다. kyomincenter는 ChatGPT 구독 릴레이(AGT-132)를 먼저, Workers AI를 다음으로 두었고, 같은 사진 20장에서 릴레이도 제목·카테고리 18/20, 중앙값 4.1초였다(Workers AI는 18/20, 4.2초).

## OPS-459 — Workers 무료 플랜에서 한글 OG 이미지(PNG)를 그리는 법: resvg-wasm을 별도 Worker로 두고 글꼴은 Google Fonts `text=` 부분 집합으로 받는다

`측정 2026-10-17 · Cloudflare Workers Free · @resvg/resvg-wasm 2.6.2 · wrangler 4.135 · Google Fonts css2 API(Noto Sans KR 600/800)`

**증상:** 카카오톡·문자 미리보기는 SVG `og:image`를 그리지 않는다. 그래서 Worker 안에서 PNG를 만들어야 한다. 그런데 한글 글꼴 하나가 굵기마다 수 MB여서 번들에 넣으면 무료 플랜의 3 MiB(gzip) 한도를 넘고, 사이트 Worker에 렌더러를 넣으면 모든 요청의 시작 비용이 커진다.

- `https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Noto+Sans+KR:wght@600;800&text=<필요한 글자>`는 굵기마다 `@font-face`를 따로 주고, 그 글자만 담은 **TrueType**을 준다. User-Agent가 없는 Worker `fetch`와 node, curl 모두 `format('truetype')`을 받았다. 카드 한 장에 굵기당 22–27 KB였다. resvg는 woff2를 읽지 못하므로 이 점이 중요하다.
- resvg-wasm만 넣은 별도 Worker는 `Total Upload: 2494 KiB / gzip: 981 KiB`, `Worker Startup Time: 4 ms`였다. `.wasm`은 wrangler 기본 규칙(CompiledWasm)으로 `import wasm from '@resvg/resvg-wasm/index_bg.wasm'` → `initWasm(wasm)`가 바로 된다. PNG 같은 바이트 파일은 `"rules": [{ "type": "Data", "globs": ["**/*.png"] }]`로 넣는다.
- `new Resvg(svg, { font: { fontBuffers: [bold, regular], defaultFontFamily: 'Noto Sans KR' } })`에서 `font-weight` 600/800은 받은 두 파일로 갈린다.
- 1200×630 카드 렌더는 M1 node에서 22–103 ms였다. 운영 사이트를 거친 요청은 처음 520 ms, 캐시 적중 뒤 106–220 ms였다.
- resvg는 줄바꿈을 하지 않는다. 받은 TTF의 `cmap`(format 4/12)과 `hmtx`를 직접 읽어 글자 폭을 재면 단어 단위 줄바꿈과 말줄임을 정확히 할 수 있다(60줄 정도).
- 카카오톡(안드로이드, Pixel 7 Pro, 2026-10-17) 링크 미리보기는 1200×630 그림의 아래쪽 약 5%를 잘라 보여 준다. 마지막 줄은 아래 끝에서 70 px 넘게 띄운다. 카카오는 페이지 주소별로 미리보기를 캐시하므로 다시 확인할 때는 `?s=2` 같은 쿼리를 붙여 새로 긁게 한다. 그림 배치를 바꿀 때는 `og:image`의 `?v=`에 배치 버전도 넣어야 이미 저장된 그림이 바뀐다.
- `Response`에 `Uint8Array`를 그대로 넣으면 workers-types에서 타입 오류(ts2345)가 난다. `png.slice().buffer as ArrayBuffer`로 넘긴다.

**해결:** 렌더러는 route 없는 Worker(`workers_dev: false`)로 두고 사이트는 서비스 바인딩으로 JSON을 보낸다. 사이트는 결과를 `caches.default`에 내용 해시 키로 넣고, `og:image` 주소에 `?v=<해시>`를 붙여 내용이 바뀌면 채팅 앱이 새로 받게 한다. 렌더가 실패하면 기존 아이콘으로 302를 보낸다. 같은 날 Air의 로컬 `wrangler dev`(workerd)는 몇 분 동안 호스트 이름으로 나가는 fetch가 모두 시간 초과였다(IP 주소로는 됐다). 같은 시각 curl도 실패했으므로 workerd 문제가 아니라 망 문제로 보고 다시 시도한다.

## OPS-460 — api.weather.gov `alerts/active?zone=`는 카운티 코드(`NJC003`)도 받고 쉼표 목록도 받는다: 카운티 코드는 그 카운티에 걸친 예보구역 경보까지 모두 잡는다

`측정 2026-10-17 · api.weather.gov (curl, User-Agent 지정)`

**증상:** 지역 경보 배너를 만들 때 예보구역(`NJZ104`)과 카운티(`NJC003`) 중 무엇을 넣어야 하는지, 여러 개를 한 번에 물을 수 있는지 문서만으로는 분명하지 않다.

- `https://api.weather.gov/alerts/active?zone=NJC003` → 200 `application/geo+json`. 카운티 코드가 그대로 통한다. 경보가 예보구역 UGC(`NJZ002`)로만 발령돼도 `zone=NJC031`(그 구역이 속한 카운티)로 같은 경보가 나온다.
- 쉼표 목록(`zone=NJZ104,NJZ002`)과 반복 파라미터(`zone=NJZ104&zone=NJZ002`) 둘 다 합집합을 돌려준다. 반복형은 응답 `title`에 마지막 구역 이름만 적지만 결과는 합집합이다. 카운티·구역 섞기(`zone=NJZ103,NJZ104,NJC003`)도 된다. 없는 코드는 400 `application/problem+json`.
- 카운티는 넓으면 과하게 잡는다. 같은 시각 `zone=CAC037`(LA 카운티)은 7건(산악 Red Flag Warning 포함), `zone=CAZ368`(LA 도심 내륙 해안)은 1건(Heat Advisory)이었다.
- 위치→코드는 `GET /points/{lat},{lon}`의 `properties.county`, `properties.forecastZone`으로 얻는다.
- 약 130회 호출 중 3회가 JSON이 아닌 응답이었다(1회는 HTML "500 Internal Server Error"로 확인). 응답 헤더는 `cache-control: public, max-age=5`, `access-control-allow-origin: *`. User-Agent 없이도 200이 나왔지만 문서는 요구한다.
- feature `properties`의 `web`은 늘 `http://www.weather.gov`라 사람용 링크로 못 쓴다. `https://forecast.weather.gov/showsigwx.php?warnzone=<구역>&warncounty=<카운티>`는 200이고 같은 경보 본문을 보여 준다. `alerts.weather.gov`는 DNS가 풀리지 않았다.

**해결:** 좁은 지역은 예보구역 코드를, 카운티 전체가 한 구역인 곳(텍사스·조지아 카운티 등)은 카운티 코드를 쓴다. 쉼표 목록 한 번으로 묻고, `content-type`이 `application/geo+json`이 아니면 직전 캐시를 그대로 보여 준다. robots.txt가 모든 봇을 막는 점(OPS-269)은 크롤러 규칙이고 이 API 호출과는 별개다.

## OPS-461 — NJ Transit 운행 공지는 키 없는 RSS 4개로 열린다: 버스 RSS는 노선마다 같은 공지를 복제해 넣고, GTFS-RT 경보는 승인제 계정이 필요하다

`측정 2026-10-17 · njtransit.com RSS · developer.njtransit.com`

**증상:** NJ Transit 경보를 서버에서 가져오려 하면 개발자 포털(`developer.njtransit.com`)은 가입·승인을 요구하고, 공개 피드 주소는 사이트 어디에도 잘 안 보인다.

- 키 없이 200 `application/xml`: `https://www.njtransit.com/rss/BusAdvisories_feed.xml`(253 item, 175 KB), `/rss/RailAdvisories_feed.xml`(42), `/rss/LightRailAdvisories_feed.xml`, `/rss/CustomerNotices_feed.xml`. Cloudflare 뒤에 있고 `cache-control: no-cache, private`. robots.txt는 `/rss/`를 막지 않는다(`/node/`는 막는다).
- item 필드: `title`, `description`, `link`(`/node/<id>`), `guid`, `pubDate`(`Oct 17, 2026 02:07:56 PM` 형식, 시간대 없음), `advisoryAlert`, `bnb`, `alert_message_components`(비어 있음).
- 버스 `title`은 `BUS <노선번호> - <날짜>`라 노선으로 거를 수 있다. 공지 하나가 노선 수만큼 복제된다(253 item 중 고유 `guid` 106개). 2025년 11월 공지도 남아 있어 날짜 필터가 필요하다.
- 철도 `title`은 날짜뿐이고 노선 이름은 `description`에 글로 있다("Port Jervis Line: …", 실시간 문구는 "MBPJ train #1717 …" 같은 약칭).
- 관찰상 `advisoryAlert=0`은 그날의 실시간 알림(지연·우회), `1`은 걸어 둔 계획 공지, 빈 값은 일반 공지였다. 공식 설명은 찾지 못했다.
- GTFS-RT: `POST https://pcsdata.njtransit.com/api/GTFSG2/getAlerts`(버스), `POST https://raildata.njtransit.com/api/GTFSRT/getAlerts`(철도), 모두 `multipart/form-data`의 `token`. 토큰은 `authenticateUser` / `getToken`에 username·password를 보내 받는다. 토큰 없이 부르면 500 `{"errorMessage":"Invalid token."}`. 포털 가입 양식은 이름·이메일·회사·주소·시·주·ZIP·전화·요청 API·약관 동의이고 "최대 5영업일" 승인 뒤에야 로그인된다. 데이터 엔드포인트는 보통 하루 40,000회 제한이다(포털 문서 번들 기준).

**해결:** 배너는 RSS로 시작한다. `guid`로 중복을 지우고, 버스는 제목의 노선번호로, 철도는 설명문의 노선 이름으로 거른다. GTFS-RT가 필요하면 포털에서 가입한 뒤 토큰을 수명 동안 캐시한다(토큰 발급 자체에 따로 제한이 있다).

## OPS-462 — 카카오톡 인앱 브라우저(Android): `kakaotalk://web/openExternal`은 일반 VIEW 인텐트라 설치된 WebAPK가 받고, `kakaotalk://inappbrowser/close`는 인앱 창을 실제로 닫는다. adb로 여는 `kakaotalk://inappbrowser?url=`은 주소를 싣지 않는다

`측정 2026-10-17 · Pixel 7 Pro · Android 17 · KakaoTalk 26.8.3 · Android System WebView 154.0.8037.106 · adb`

**증상:** 카톡 인앱 브라우저에서의 동작을 실기기로 확인하려 할 때 막히는 지점 세 가지.

- `adb shell am start -a android.intent.action.VIEW -d "kakaotalk://inappbrowser?url=<인코딩된 URL>" com.kakao.talk`은 `InAppBrowserActivity`를 띄우지만 주소창이 비어 있고 아무 페이지도 열지 않는다. 주소창(`com.kakao.talk:id/webview_navi_address_bar`)을 탭하고 `input text <URL>` + `KEYCODE_ENTER`로 열면 된다. 주소창을 비울 때는 `input keycombination 113 29`(Ctrl+A) 뒤 `KEYCODE_DEL`. 길게 누른 DEL로는 지워지지 않아 URL이 이어 붙어 404가 났다. 이렇게 연 페이지의 UA에는 `KAKAOTALK`이 들어 있어 사이트의 인앱 분기가 그대로 탄다.
- 카톡 WebView는 원격 디버깅이 꺼져 있다. `/proc/net/unix`에 `webview_devtools_remote_<pid>` 소켓이 없어 CDP로 DOM을 읽을 수 없다. 화면 확인은 `screencap`과 `uiautomator dump`(WebView 안의 텍스트·버튼 bounds가 나온다)로 한다.
- 페이지가 `location.href = 'kakaotalk://web/openExternal?url=…'`을 실행하면 카톡은 특정 브라우저가 아닌 일반 VIEW 인텐트를 보낸다. 그 사이트가 WebAPK(설치된 PWA)로 깔린 폰에서는 Chrome 탭이 아니라 `org.chromium.chrome.browser.webapps.SameTaskWebApkActivity`가 앞에 왔다. 이어서 페이지가 hidden이 된 뒤 `location.href = 'kakaotalk://inappbrowser/close'`를 실행하면 `InAppBrowserActivity`가 카톡 태스크의 히스토리에서 사라진다(남은 것은 `ChatRoomHolderActivity`·`MainActivity`). 앱 화면에서 뒤로 가도 빈 인앱 창이 남지 않는다.

**해결:** 인앱 탈출 버튼을 실기기에서 검증할 때는 주소창에 직접 입력해 페이지를 연다. 탭 뒤에는 `dumpsys window | grep mCurrentFocus`(누가 앞에 왔는지)와 `dumpsys activity activities | grep -E 'Hist.*kakao'`(인앱 창이 닫혔는지)로 판정한다. WebAPK가 깔려 있으면 "Chrome에서 열기"가 설치된 앱을 연다는 점을 버튼 문구와 기대 결과에 반영한다. iOS의 `kakaoweb://closeBrowser`는 이 측정에 포함되지 않았다.

## OPS-463 — Google 지도 길찾기 URL로 "평일 오전 8시 출발"을 고정하는 법: `data=` 안의 `!8j`는 현지 벽시계 시각을 UTC인 것처럼 적은 epoch다

`측정 2026-10-17 · Google Maps 웹 (hl=en) · Brave 1.96 (Chromium 154) on macOS · 67개 동네 출퇴근 측정`

**증상:** 동네별 출근 시간을 "평일 오전 8시 출발" 같은 같은 조건으로 재야 하는데, `maps/dir/?api=1&…` 형식에는 출발 시각 파라미터가 없다. UI에서 "Depart at"을 매번 고르면 67곳을 재는 동안 실수가 생긴다.

길찾기 URL의 `data=` 조각에 출발 시각을 넣을 수 있다:
`https://www.google.com/maps/dir/<lat,lng>/<목적지>/data=!4m6!4m5!2m3!6e0!7e2!8j<초>!3e<모드>?hl=en`
- `6e0` = Depart at (`6e1`은 Arrive by), `3e3` = 대중교통, `3e0` = 운전.
- `8j` 값은 **그 지역 현지 시각 08:00을 UTC 08:00인 것처럼** 계산한 epoch 초다. 2026-10-20 08:00은 뉴저지·LA·댈러스·덴버·애틀랜타 어디서나 `8j1792483200`이고, 화면에 "Depart at 8:00 AM, Tue, Oct 20"이 그 지역 시각으로 뜬다. 진짜 UTC epoch(예: EDT 08:00 = 12:00Z)를 넣으면 4~7시간 어긋난다.
- 운전은 "typically 30–55 min" 범위로 나온다. 대중교통은 여러 출발 시각이 섞여 나오므로 "08:00~08:30 출발 중 최단"처럼 기준을 정해 고른다.

함정: 한 곳(텍사스 Coppell)은 화요일로 고정해도 토요일 새벽 경로만 돌려줬다. 다른 날로 다시 재도 같았다. 이런 값은 버린다. ZIP 중심 좌표가 시가지 밖에 떨어지는 경우는 OPS-466을 본다.

**해결:** 출발 시각은 `!8j<현지 벽시계 시각을 UTC로 친 epoch>`로 URL에 고정한다. 측정마다 화면의 "Depart at …" 문구를 스크린샷으로 남겨 실제로 적용됐는지 확인한다.

## OPS-464 — H마트 매장 좌표는 hmart.com의 공개 VTEX 픽업 지점 API에서 한 번에 받는다

`측정 2026-10-17 · www.hmart.com (VTEX) · 미국 5개 권역 매장`

**증상:** hmart.com/stores 매장 목록은 주소만 화면에 그린다. 좌표를 얻으려고 주소마다 지오코딩을 하면 느리고, 상가 주소에서 수십 m씩 어긋난다.

사이트가 쓰는 VTEX 엔드포인트가 인증 없이 열려 있다:
`https://www.hmart.com/api/checkout/pub/pickup-points?geoCoordinates=<경도>;<위도>&page=1&pageSize=50`
기준점 주변 매장이 이름·주소·좌표·영업 여부와 함께 JSON으로 온다. **좌표 순서는 경도;위도다.** 뉴저지 매장 3곳을 Nominatim과 대조했더니 30m 안이었다. 콜로라도에는 H마트가 없다(2026-10-17).
