**해결:** 매장 좌표는 이 API로 받고, 출처로 hmart.com 매장 페이지를 함께 적는다. 다른 한인 마트(시온마켓, 갤러리아 등)는 각자 공식 사이트에서 따로 확인한다.

## OPS-465 — overseas.mofa.go.kr(재외공관 사이트)는 curl에 307 + 쿠키를 무한히 돌려준다: 쿠키 저장소와 브라우저 UA가 있으면 열린다

`측정 2026-10-17 · overseas.mofa.go.kr · curl 8.x`

**증상:** 영사관 주소나 관할을 확인하려고 `curl -L`로 공관 페이지를 받으면 `307` 응답과 `Set-Cookie: TMOSHCooKie=…`이 반복되다가 리디렉트 한도에 걸려 끝난다. 본문은 받지 못한다.

**해결:** 쿠키를 저장하고 다시 보내면 된다. `curl -L -c jar -b jar -A "Mozilla/5.0 …"`처럼 쿠키 저장소(`-c`/`-b`)와 브라우저 User-Agent를 함께 주면 두 번째 요청에서 200이 온다. 공관 관할은 외교부 공관 목록표를 기준으로 삼는다. 예를 들어 콜로라도는 주샌프란시스코 총영사관 관할이고, 콜로라도 안에는 공관이 없다.

## OPS-466 — ZIP(ZCTA) 중심 좌표가 시가지 밖에 떨어지는 ZIP이 있다: 어바인 92618의 중심은 자연보호구역 안이다

`측정 2026-10-17 · api.zippopotam.us · Google Maps`

**증상:** ZIP 중심점에서 출근 시간과 마트 거리를 쟀더니, 어바인(92618)만 운전 85–150분에 대중교통 경로 없음이 나왔다. Google은 그 점을 "Limestone Canyon Nature Preserve, Silverado 92676"으로 읽었다. 넓은 ZIP은 면적 중심이 사람이 사는 곳과 동떨어질 수 있다.

**해결:** 넓은 교외 ZIP은 중심 좌표를 지도에서 한 번 열어 본다. 시가지 밖이면 그 ZIP 안의 대표 지점(92618은 Irvine Spectrum Center, 33.6506,-117.7435)으로 바꾸고, 바꿨다는 사실을 데이터 옆에 남긴다.

## OPS-467 — Android Chrome에서 CDP `Runtime.evaluate`로 누른 버튼은 Google 로그인 팝업을 못 연다: `Input.dispatchTouchEvent`는 사용자 탭으로 친다

`측정 2026-10-17 · Pixel 7 Pro · Chrome for Android · adb forward tcp:9333 localabstract:chrome_devtools_remote`

**증상:** 실기기 Chrome에서 사이트의 "Google로 로그인"을 `element.click()`(CDP `Runtime.evaluate`)으로 누르면 아무 일도 없다. 화면에는 "팝업을 허용해 주세요"만 남는다. 사용자 제스처가 없는 `window.open`이라 막힌 것이다.

**해결:** 버튼의 `getBoundingClientRect()` 중심(CSS px)을 구해 같은 탭에 CDP `Input.dispatchTouchEvent`(`touchStart` → `touchEnd`)로 보낸다. 이것은 사용자 탭으로 처리되어 Google 계정 선택 탭이 새로 열린다. 그 탭의 `[data-email="…"]` 위치를 같은 방법으로 탭하면 로그인이 끝난다. `json/list`에는 기기 주인의 개인 탭도 다 나오니, 대상 탭 id만 골라 쓰고 목록을 출력하지 않는다.

함께 확인한 것: 이 공유 Pixel의 Chrome은 Android 알림 권한(`POST_NOTIFICATIONS`)이 `granted=false, flags=[USER_SET|USER_FIXED]`였다(`dumpsys package com.android.chrome`). 이 경우 `Notification.permission`이 사이트와 상관없이 `denied`이고, 사이트 설정에는 알림 항목이 보이지도 않는다. 기기 주인이 끈 설정이므로 세션이 바꾸지 않는다. 웹 푸시 실기기 확인은 다른 브라우저로 한다(OPS-468).

## OPS-468 — Astro dev: a second server in the same project is refused, and a copy with a symlinked node_modules breaks both

`측정 2026-10-17 · Astro 7.3.3 · Vite (rolldown) · @astrojs/cloudflare 14.3.2 · MacBook Air M1 (공유 테스트 호스트)`

**증상:** on a shared test host another session's `astro dev` was still running in the project directory. A second
`npx astro dev --port 4337` in the same directory exited at once:

```
Another astro dev server is already running.
  URL:  http://127.0.0.1:4331
Run `astro dev stop` to stop it, or use `astro dev --force` to replace it.
```

`--force` would kill the other session's server. A copy of the project with `node_modules` as a symlink to the original
started, but after `astro check` ran in the copy, its pages answered 500 with:

```
[ERROR] [vite] Internal server error: The file does not exist at ".../node_modules/.vite/deps_ssr/path-DB-KzNNv.js?v=30b6fb21"
which is in the optimize deps directory.
```

The dependency-optimizer cache (`node_modules/.vite`) lives inside `node_modules`, so every server and `astro check`
sharing that `node_modules` rewrites the same cache under the others.

**해결:** run your own server from your own copy with its own `node_modules`. On APFS a clone is instant and takes no
space: `rsync -a --exclude node_modules --exclude .astro --exclude dist <project>/ <copy>/ && cp -cR <project>/node_modules
<copy>/node_modules && rm -rf <copy>/node_modules/.vite`, then `npx astro dev --port <your port>` in the copy. Never
symlink `node_modules`, and never `--force` a server you did not start.

## OPS-469 — Brave hides any element whose class starts with `ad-` (`.ad-top`, `.ad-nav`…), headless included

`측정 2026-10-17 · Brave 1.96 (Chromium 154) · Playwright launch with executablePath, headless · default Shields`

**증상:** an admin console's sticky header (`<header class="ad-top">`) and its menu (`.ad-nav`, `.ad-user`) were missing
from every screenshot. The HTML was there; `getComputedStyle(header).display` was `none` and its bounding box `null`.
No site CSS hid it. Brave's built-in cosmetic filter (Shields, on by default, also in a fresh headless profile) matches
generic ad class names such as `ad-top`, so readers with Brave or any EasyList blocker lose the element too.

**해결:** never start a class or id with `ad-`/`ads`/`advert`/`sponsor`/`banner` for real UI. Renaming to `nr-*` fixed it at
once. When an element is present in the DOM but `display: none` with no matching rule in your CSS, suspect the content
blocker before your code.

## OPS-470 — Workers edge-cached HTML outlives a deploy and points at deleted `/_astro/*` files: key the cache by version

`측정 2026-10-17 · Cloudflare Workers (Free) · Astro 7 · @astrojs/cloudflare 14 · Cache API (caches.default)`

**증상:** a Worker that keeps rendered pages in `caches.default` (stale-while-revalidate) was redeployed. Cached pages kept
referencing the previous build's hashed `/_astro/app.<hash>.js`, which the new deploy's static assets no longer had, so
pages came up without JavaScript: Alpine never started, buttons did nothing, and no page error was logged.

**해결:** bind `"version_metadata": { "binding": "CF_VERSION_METADATA" }` and put `env.CF_VERSION_METADATA.id` into the cache key
(`https://edge.cache/<version>/<path>`). Every deploy starts with an empty cache and old copies expire on their own. Purging
is not an option on Workers: `cache.delete` only clears the data center that runs it.

## OPS-471 — Migrating a Korean "한국형 신문 CMS" news site (thenewsin.co.kr family): what the HTML really looks like

`측정 2026-10-17 · www.biznewyork.net (CMS per robots.txt → thenewsin.co.kr) · node-html-parser 7`

**증상:** article numbers (`/news/article.html?no=N`) are sparse: of 1–6147 only 2,945 exist; a missing number answers
**200** with a 197-byte page holding `window.alert('기사번호가 누락되어 있거나 잘못된 접근입니다.')`, so status codes cannot tell
missing from present (check length or `news_body_area`). The headline is written `<h1>…</h2>`, which breaks any HTML
parser's tree under `.art_top`: the byline (`ul.art_info li`: "Jung Lee 기자", "등록 2026.10.11 14:56:16") comes out empty.
The body is `#news_body_area` (Smart Editor): `<p><br></p>` spacers, inline styles, photo captions as the next paragraph with
`font-size: 13px`, images as `<img xtype="photo" src="//www…/data/photos/YYYYMMWW/art_….jpg">`, list thumbnails under
`/data/cache/public/photos/…_190x143_c0.jpg`. Dates are New York local time without an offset. The Google News sitemap
labels every article `PressRelease`.

**해결:** read the byline block with a regex on the raw HTML, the body with a parser. Treat a short 200 as missing. Convert
`YYYY.MM.DD HH:MM:SS` as America/New_York (DST-aware). 5 parallel requests copied the whole site with images (604 MB) in
18 minutes with no failures. Map old addresses with 301s: `article.html?no=N` and `mobile/article.html?no=N` → the new
article, `section_list_all.html?sec_no=X` → the new section, `/data/photos/…` → the migrated image.

## OPS-472 — Telling whether a job posting is still open without a browser: each ATS needs its own signal, and UCHealth's closed page still answers 200

`측정 2026-10-17 · Greenhouse · Workday · UKG Pro (recruiting.ultipro.com) · ADP Workforce Now · SuccessFactors career site · plain curl/fetch and PocketBase 0.40.4 $http.send from AWS us-west-2`

**증상:** an automatic "close the post when the source closes" check that looks only at the HTTP status of the posting URL marks almost nothing closed. Several boards are single-page apps that answer 200 with the same shell for open, closed and invented job IDs; Greenhouse redirects a gone job to `/{board}?error=true` (200); UCHealth's careers site shows "This job posting is no longer active." on a 200 page in a browser and answers 403 to curl, Node fetch and WebFetch (and tarpits curl until timeout from a home network).

Signals that held for real open postings and invented IDs:

| Board | Ask | Open | Closed |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Greenhouse `job-boards.greenhouse.io/{board}/jobs/{id}` | `https://boards-api.greenhouse.io/v1/boards/{board}/jobs/{id}` | 200 JSON | 404 `Job not found` |
| Workday `{tenant}.wdN.myworkdayjobs.com/[locale/]{site}/job/{path}` | GET `https://{host}/wday/cxs/{tenant}/{site}/job/{path}` | 200 with `jobPostingInfo` | 404 |
| UKG Pro `…/OpportunityDetail?opportunityId={uuid}` | the page itself | HTML embeds `CandidateOpportunityDetail({"Id":"{uuid}",…` | 200 page (~42 KB) without it |
| ADP `…/recruitment.html?cid=…&ccId=…&jobId={id}` | `https://workforcenow.adp.com/mascsr/default/careercenter/public/events/staffing/v1/job-requisitions/{id}?cid=…&lang=en_US&ccId=…` | 200 with `"itemID":"{id}"` | 200 skeleton (`postingInstructions` but no `itemID`) |
| SuccessFactors career site `/job/{slug}/{number}/` | the page | page contains the number | redirect to `/errorpage/?errortype=…` (200) |
| County / small-employer WordPress pages | the page | 200 | 404 |

**해결:** pick the signal per board, treat 403/429/5xx/network errors as "unknown" (never closed), and close only after two "closed" answers at least ~20 hours apart. For a careers page that lists several jobs on one URL, store the job as a text fragment (`…/careers#:~:text=Teller%20(Olympic%20Branch)`) and treat "text gone from the page" as closed; readers' browsers also jump to that line. When every post on one board answers closed in the same run, assume the board changed its markup and close none. Run the check from a server: PocketBase's pure-Go `$http.send` on a macOS home network (the Air) spent 6–8 s per DNS lookup and hit its timeout on most hosts, while the same hook on the Linux host answered all of them.

## OPS-473 — `wrangler dev` 4.135.0 refuses `compatibility_date` later than 2026-09-25; `wrangler deploy` does not

`측정 2026-10-17 · wrangler 4.135.0 (workerd bundled with it) · macOS (MacBook Air M1)`

**증상:** a new Worker set `"compatibility_date": "2026-10-01"`. `wrangler deploy` uploaded it without a word, but `wrangler dev` on the same config printed the bindings and then died:

```
service core:user:<name>: This Worker requires compatibility date "2026-10-01", but the newest date supported by this server binary is "2026-09-25".
The Workers runtime failed to start. There was likely a problem with the workerd binary or your configuration.
Error [ERR_IPC_CHANNEL_CLOSED]: Channel closed
```

The local server never listens, so a test that waits for the port only sees `ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED`; the cause is in the dev log, not in the test output.

**해결:** set `compatibility_date` no later than the date the error names (2026-09-25 for 4.135.0), or upgrade wrangler. Keep the deployed and local dates the same so the local run tests what ships.

## OPS-474 — Cloudflare Access with Google sign-in, set up without a person: Google Auth Platform client by Playwright, IdP and app through the dashboard session

`측정 2026-10-17 · Google Cloud console, Korean UI (Google 인증 플랫폼) · Cloudflare Zero Trust free · Brave 1.96 headed on the Air, profile copied from ~/kc-test/profile`

**증상:** a hostname had to be limited to one Google account. The account's Zero Trust had only the one-time PIN identity provider. Three things did not work as earlier notes (OPS-332, OPS-428) describe:

- `console.cloud.google.com/apis/credentials/oauthclient?project=<id>` now redirects to `/auth/clients`, and the create page `/auth/clients/create?project=<id>` has **no `mat-select`** (count 0). There are two comboboxes on the page; the first is the console search bar.
- A `POST /accounts/<id>/access/identity_providers` sent through the dashboard session (OPS-301) from the account home page a few seconds after load came back **403 with an HTML page titled "Attention Required! | Cloudflare"**, not JSON. From `dash.cloudflare.com/<account>/one` after a 10 s wait, the same kind of POST answered 201, and a `PUT` of the real client ID and secret onto that provider answered 200. Whether the first failure came from the page or the body is not known.
- The Cloudflare dashboard session in an older dedicated profile had expired, and that profile was not signed in to Google, so "Continue with Google" stopped at the Google identifier page.

**해결:**

1. Copy the signed-in Google profile without caches (`rsync -a --exclude Cache --exclude "Code Cache" --exclude GPUCache --exclude CacheStorage --exclude "Singleton*"`; 905 MB became 188 MB) and use the copy, so the original stays free for other sessions. On `dash.cloudflare.com/login`, click the button named Google; Google signs in with no chooser.
2. Google client: open `/auth/clients/create?project=<id>`, click `getByRole('combobox', { name: /애플리케이션 유형/ })`, pick the option `웹 애플리케이션`, fill `input[formcontrolname=displayName]`, click the **last** `URI 추가` button (the second one is under 승인된 리디렉션 URI) and type `https://<team>.cloudflareaccess.com/cdn-cgi/access/callback` with `page.keyboard`, then `만들기`. Poll the page text every 500 ms for `*.apps.googleusercontent.com` and `GOCSPX-…` and write both to a 0600 file without printing.
3. From `/<account>/one` (wait 10 s), `POST access/identity_providers {"name":"Google","type":"google","config":{"client_id":…,"client_secret":…}}`; if it answers HTML, create it with placeholder values and `PUT` the real ones. Then `POST access/apps` with `type: self_hosted`, `domain`, `allowed_idps: [<google id>]`, `auto_redirect_to_identity: true` and an inline policy `{"decision":"allow","include":[{"email":{"email":<owner>}}]}`. Read `aud` from the app for the Worker's JWT check.
4. Create the Access app **before** deploying the Worker on that hostname, so the first request already meets the login.

Measured: unauthenticated `https://<host>/` answered 302 to `<team>.cloudflareaccess.com/cdn-cgi/access/login/<host>`; the copied profile then reached the page signed in with no clicks, and the Worker saw a valid `Cf-Access-Jwt-Assertion` (RS256, verified against `/cdn-cgi/access/certs`).
