## OPS-475 — Cloudflare Workers 정시 크론이 보낸 Web Push는 27분 열어 둔 Brave 세션에 그대로 도착한다: 크론 정각에서 55초 뒤 표시

`측정 2026-10-17 · Brave 1.96 (Chromium 154) · playwright-core · macOS (MacBook Air M1) · Cloudflare Workers cron "0 * * * *"`

**증상:** OPS-330 방식(구독·발송·표시를 한 브라우저 세션 안에서)으로는 서버가 **나중에** 보내는 푸시(매시 크론, 배치 알림)를
시험하기 어렵다. 세션을 닫았다 다시 열면 구독이 사라진 것처럼 보이기 때문이다.

이 측정에서는 headed Brave(프로필 복사본 + `brave.gcm.channel_status=true`)를 띄웠다. 운영 사이트에서 알림을 구독하고 시험 글을
올린 뒤 **그 세션을 그대로 열어 둔 채** 다음 정각 크론을 기다렸다. 구독은 18:33Z였고, 19:00Z 크론이 보낸 푸시가 19:00:55Z에
`registration.getNotifications()`로 잡혔다. 그 사이 세션은 27분 동안 아무 입력 없이 열려 있었다. endpoint는 `fcm.googleapis.com`였다.

**해결:** 서버 쪽 일정 작업이 보내는 푸시를 실제로 받으려면 브라우저 세션을 크론이 돌 때까지 닫지 말고, 30초 간격으로
`getNotifications()`를 확인한다. 루프는 크론 정각 + 2분까지 돌린다. 끝나면 시험 글과 구독을 같은 페이지에서 지우고 프로필 복사본도
지운다. Android Chrome은 앱 수준 알림 권한(POST_NOTIFICATIONS)이 사용자 거부(USER_FIXED) 상태면 이 시험을 할 수 없다.
그 기기 설정은 기기 주인의 것이니 이 경우 Brave(Air)로 대신한다.

## OPS-476 — `astro dev` / `wrangler dev` on the Air: every outgoing fetch from a freshly installed `workerd` times out (LuLu has no rule for that path); point Miniflare at an already allowed `workerd` with `MINIFLARE_WORKERD_PATH`

`측정 2026-10-17 · MacBook Air M1 · astro 7.3.3 · @astrojs/cloudflare 14.3.2 · workerd 1.20260918.1 · LuLu (alert mode)`

**증상:** in a new worktree (`npm ci` just run), an Astro endpoint's `fetch` to any internet host timed out — `https://example.com/`, `https://1.1.1.1/`, `https://api.weather.gov/…`, the kc-llm relay — each `TimeoutError` after the full timeout, while `http://127.0.0.1:8097` (a local PocketBase) answered in 5 ms and `curl` from the same shell got 200 in 0.5 s. A text-model feature silently fell back to its rules ("source": "rules") and looked like a slow model. Restarting the dev server changed nothing.

- LuLu rules are per binary **path**. `plutil -convert xml1 -o - /Library/Objective-See/LuLu/rules.plist | grep workerd` listed `workerd` under other worktrees (`kyomincenter-market`, `kc-housing`, …) but not the new one, so its connections were held for a console prompt nobody on ssh sees (same mechanism as OPS-227).
- Every worktree's `node_modules/@cloudflare/workerd-darwin-arm64/bin/workerd` is a new path, so each new worktree hits this once.

**해결:** start the dev server with an allowed binary of the same version:
`MINIFLARE_WORKERD_PATH=/Users/chowooick/work/kyomincenter-market/node_modules/@cloudflare/workerd-darwin-arm64/bin/workerd npx astro dev --port <port>` (check the version in that package's `package.json` first). `pgrep -lf workerd` then shows the allowed path, and the same probe returned 200 in 96–216 ms. Before blaming DNS or the remote host, probe one plain host (`https://example.com/`) from an endpoint and compare with `curl`.

## OPS-477 — WebFetch on Sefaria and Quran.com pages returns no scripture text (Sefaria: "Loading…", Quran.com: only the first verse of a range); read them through `sefaria.org/api/texts/…` or one verse per page

`측정 2026-10-17 · Claude Code WebFetch · https://www.sefaria.org/Bereshit_Rabbah.56.8 · https://quran.com/37/99-113`

**증상:** a research run cited a midrash and a Quran passage, but WebFetch of the reader pages gave nothing to cite. Sefaria's page held the site header, the title "Bereshit Rabbah 56:8" and a body of only `Loading...`. Quran.com's range page `/37/99-113` returned verse 99 alone; verses 100–113 were not in the fetched text. Both sites render the text with JavaScript after load.

**해결:** for Sefaria, fetch `https://www.sefaria.org/api/texts/<Ref>?context=0` (e.g. `/api/texts/Bereshit_Rabbah.56.8?context=0`): the JSON `text`/`he` fields hold the English and Hebrew, footnotes included (a sentence such as "So it must be that Isaac consented to be bound." there is the translator's gloss, not the midrash). For Quran.com, fetch one verse per page (`https://quran.com/37:102`) or a tafsir page, which return their text. Cite the human-readable page URL in the study, and note in the source notes that it was read through the API or verse by verse. A provenance gate that compares cited URLs with fetched URLs then needs the reader URL in the fetch record too, or an allowance for the API form.

## OPS-478 — `wrangler dev` gives the Worker `request.url` with the route's custom-domain host, not 127.0.0.1; pass `--local-upstream` to keep it

`측정 2026-10-17 · wrangler 4.135.0 · config with `"routes": [{ "pattern": "<host>", "custom_domain": true }]` · Air (M1)`

**증상:** a Worker allowed a local-only shortcut (skip the Access JWT check) when `new URL(request.url).hostname` was `127.0.0.1` or `localhost`. Under `wrangler dev --ip 127.0.0.1 --port 8795`, `curl http://127.0.0.1:8795/dashboard` still answered 403: the Worker saw `request.url` as `http://<custom-domain host>/dashboard`. Nothing in the dev log says the URL was rewritten.

**해결:** start dev with `--local-upstream 127.0.0.1:<port>`; `request.url` then keeps `127.0.0.1` and the check works. With that flag the Host header no longer matters (a request sent with `Host: <custom-domain host>` also arrived as 127.0.0.1), so key such shortcuts on a dev-only variable in `.dev.vars` **and** the hostname, never on the hostname alone, and never set the variable in production.

## OPS-479 — Two `wrangler dev` processes on one project and one D1 database: started together, one dies with `SQLITE_BUSY_RECOVERY`

`측정 2026-10-17 · wrangler 4.135.0 · two configs (`wrangler.jsonc`, `wrangler.plan.jsonc`) binding the same `database_id` · local state in `.wrangler/state``

**증상:** two Workers of one repo share one D1 database. Both dev servers were launched in the same second (`(npx wrangler dev … &)` twice). The second printed its bindings and then:

```
*** Fatal uncaught kj::Exception: workerd/util/sqlite.c++:873: failed: SQLite failed; dbErrorMessage(prepareResult, db) = database is locked: SQLITE_BUSY (extended: SQLITE_BUSY_RECOVERY)
The Workers runtime failed to start.
```

Its port never opened, so the test only saw `ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED`.

**해결:** both servers read the same local SQLite file under `.wrangler/state/v3/d1` (that is what lets one Worker's writes show up in the other). Start them one after the other: wait until the first answers HTTP, then start the second. Give the second its own `--inspector-port` too.

## OPS-480 — Census business-owner tables (SBO 2012, ABS) read without a key through data.census.gov's own API; Korean owners are state-only in ABS 2022

`측정 2026-10-17 · data.census.gov/api/access/data/table · SBOCS2012.SB1200CSA01 · ABSCS2022.AB2200CSA01 · ABSCS2023.AB2300CSA01`

**증상:** api.census.gov returns `302` to `missing_key.html` without a key (OPS-372), and Census Reporter (the OPS-372 workaround) carries ACS only, not the Survey of Business Owners or the Annual Business Survey. Owner-by-race counts by state or metro seem unreachable without a key.

The site's backend answers without a key when sent a browser User-Agent:
`curl -A "Mozilla/5.0" "https://data.census.gov/api/access/data/table?id=SBOCS2012.SB1200CSA01&g=010XX00US\$0400000"`
(`$0400000` = all states, `$3100000` = all metros; quote the `$` for the shell). The answer is `{"response":{"data":[header,row,…]}}` with every race, sex, ethnicity and NAICS combination, so it is large: 47 MB for all states, 76 MB for all metros. Filter rows on `RACE_GROUP_LABEL`, `NAICS2012=="00"` (or `NAICS2022`), `SEX=="001"`, `ETH_GROUP=="001"` and, for ABS, `VET_GROUP=="001"`. Money columns (`RCPALL`, `RCPPDEMP`, `PAYANN`) are in $1,000. A list of five county geo ids (`g=0500000US34003,0500000US06059,…`) returned an empty body; the all-states and all-metros forms worked.

Detailed Asian groups (Korean, Chinese, Vietnamese …): SBO 2012 has them for states and metros (all firms, employer and nonemployer). ABS 2022 has them for **states only**; its metro rows stop at `Asian`. ABS 2023 has no detailed Asian groups at all.

**해결:** for owner-by-race at metro level use SBO 2012; for a recent figure use ABS 2022 at state level (employer firms only). Send a browser User-Agent and pull the all-states or all-metros file, then filter locally.

## OPS-481 — Chrome/Playwright page.pdf() embeds a variable web font as dozens of Type 3 fonts; static instances embed as CID TrueType

`측정 2026-10-17 · Google Chrome (Playwright 1.58 page.pdf, tagged) · PretendardVariable · fontTools 4.60.2`

**증상:** an HTML page using a variable font (`@font-face { src: url(PretendardVariable.woff2) format("woff2-variations"); font-weight: 45 920 }`) printed to PDF with `page.pdf()`. The PDF looked right, but `pdffonts` listed over 300 font objects, every one `Type 3`, named like `PretendardVariable-Regular_wght28A0000` — one per weight instance per chunk. Type 3 fonts carry no hinting and some viewers, printers and PDF/A checkers treat them poorly.

**해결:** cut a static font per weight the page uses and declare each as its own `@font-face` with a single `font-weight`:

```python
from fontTools.ttLib import TTFont
from fontTools.varLib.instancer import instantiateVariableFont
for w in [450, 500, 600, 700, 800]:
    instantiateVariableFont(TTFont("PretendardVariable.ttf"), {"wght": w}).save(f"pq-{w}.ttf")
```

Then the same page prints with one `CID TrueType` font per weight (11 weights → 11 fonts, 386 KB for a 4-page Korean document), subset and with Unicode maps. Weights in CSS that are not instanced fall back by the CSS matching rules (e.g. 720 picks 800), so instance every weight the stylesheet names.

## OPS-482 — PocketBase's auto-backup zips the whole `storage` folder: with uploaded images it is hundreds of MB a day, far over Workers KV's 25 MiB per value

`측정 2026-10-18 · PocketBase 0.40.4 · Workers KV (Workers Free) · oregon t4g.small, 29 GB disk`

**증상:** a PocketBase holding 2,945 news articles and 3,790 images had `backups.cron = "30 3 * * *"`, `cronMaxKeep 14`.
`pb_data` was `data.db` 21 MB, `auxiliary.db` 9 MB, `storage` 644 MB (595 MB originals, the rest thumbnails). The
backup zip includes `storage`, so each daily backup is about 650 MB and 14 of them about 9 GB on the same disk as the
data. The off-host pattern used for a database without files (push the newest zip to a write-only Worker that stores it
in KV) cannot take it: a KV value is capped at 25 MiB, and Workers Free gives the whole account 1 GB of KV. On the same
date an existing 90-day KV backup namespace on that account already held 155 MB after 19 days (32 keys).

**해결:** turn the auto-backup off (`PATCH /api/settings {"backups":{"cron":""}}` as superuser) and split the two parts.
The database alone: `sqlite3 data.db ".backup '<tmp>/data.db'"`, `PRAGMA integrity_check`, zip (21 MB → 4.7 MB), keep a
few on the host and push to the KV Worker with a short expiry. The files: copy only originals that are new or changed in
size (skip `thumbs_*` folders; PocketBase regenerates thumbnails on request, verified with `?thumb=400x0` on a restored
copy) to a host with disk, by pulling from it. A restore needs both halves: a throwaway
`pocketbase serve --dir=<copy> --migrationsDir=<empty> --hooksDir=<empty>` on another port served records and images
from a KV snapshot plus the pulled `storage`. Run the snapshot as the service user (a systemd `User=`), not root, so
SQLite never leaves root-owned `-wal`/`-shm` files beside a database another user writes.

## OPS-483 — iPad 홈 화면 웹 앱 실기기 푸시 확인: XCUITest 러너는 같은 와이파이의 맥에 닿지 못하고(-1009), 팝업 OAuth 뒤 `location.assign`은 무시된다

`측정 2026-10-17 · iPad mini 5(iPad11,1) · iPadOS 26.7.1 · Xcode 27 XCUITest(Personal Team) · Safari 홈 화면에 추가(웹 앱으로 열기) · Web Push(web.push.apple.com)`

**증상과 사실:**
- 원격 조작용 XCUITest 러너(명령을 HTTP로 받아 실행)가 맥 `http://192.168.0.x:port`에 요청하면 매번 `NSURLConnection finished with error - code -1009`로 실패했다. 로컬 네트워크 권한 창도 뜨지 않는다. 같은 러너가 `https://<무작위>.trycloudflare.com/<비밀 경로>`(맥의 `cloudflared tunnel --url http://127.0.0.1:port`)로는 바로 통했다.
- 처음 실행할 때 기기에서 사람이 두 번 해야 한다. ① 설정 › 일반 › VPN 및 기기 관리 › 개발자 앱 '신뢰'(안 하면 `Developer App Certificate is not trusted`). ② "'XCTest'의 Touch ID · Enable UI Automation" 지문(안 하면 `Timed out while enabling automation mode`). 설정 화면은 `xcrun devicectl device process launch --device <udid> --payload-url 'prefs:root=General&path=ManagedConfigurationList' com.apple.Preferences`로 바로 열어 둘 수 있다.
- Safari 공유 시트와 '홈 화면에 추가' 시트는 `XCUIApplication(bundleIdentifier: "com.apple.mobilesafari")` 트리에 나오지 않는다(원격 뷰). `devicectl device capture screenshot`(2048×1536 px = 1024×768 pt)으로 위치를 읽어 좌표로 누른다. 시트 위치는 열 때마다 달라질 수 있으므로 누르기 전에 매번 찍는다.
- 홈 화면 웹 앱의 이름과 알림의 'from ○○'은 `<title>`을 그대로 쓴다. `<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-title" content="짧은 이름">`이 없으면 긴 제목이 잘린다. 이 이름은 추가할 때 정해지고, 나중에 메타를 넣어도 이미 추가한 아이콘에는 반영되지 않는다.
- 웹 앱에서 `window.open` 팝업으로 Google 로그인을 끝내면 앞 페이지의 `fetch('/auth/complete')`는 성공한다. 그런데 바로 부른 `location.assign(next)`는 무시되어 "로그인되었습니다"에서 40분 동안 멈춰 있었다. 세션 쿠키는 이미 들어가 있어서 링크를 누르자 로그인된 화면이 열렸다.
- Google 로그인은 패스키 창 → Touch ID를 요구했다. 세션이 할 수 없는 단계다.
- 알림 권한 창의 '허용'은 XCUITest 좌표 탭으로 눌렸다. 그 뒤 서버의 `sendPush`가 `web.push.apple.com`에서 201을 받았고, 알림이 몇 초 안에 배너로 떴다(앱이 앞에 있어도 떴다).

**해결:** 러너와 맥 사이는 임시 터널을 쓰고, 경로에 무작위 토큰을 넣는다. 끝나면 러너·터널·서버를 모두 끈다. 로그인 페이지는 성공 뒤 `document.hidden`이 풀릴 때(`visibilitychange`·`focus`) 다시 이동하게 하고 '계속하기' 링크를 남긴다. 자기 행동에는 알림을 보내지 않는 서비스라면, 관리자 본인 구독으로만 보내는 시험 알림 API를 두어야 기기 하나로 확인할 수 있다(kyomincenter `/api/admin/push-test`). 시험 구독 행은 확인 뒤 지운다(OPS-330).

## OPS-484 — PocketBase: keep existing tokens valid through an `authRule` change by putting the old `authToken.secret` back in a second save

`측정 2026-10-18 · PocketBase 0.40.4, JSVM migration on a `sqlite3 .backup` copy, then live`

**증상:** a rule rewrite that has to touch an auth collection's `authRule` (here rotating a server-header key that sits
in 76 rules, one of them `kc_members.authRule`) rotates the collection's token secret on every save that changes the
rule (OPS-204): on the copy the `options.authToken` hash changed after each of the two phases, so every member would
have been silently anonymous to the database until they signed in again.

The regeneration happens only when the saved `authRule` differs from the stored one. A second save of the same
collection with the rule already stored and only `authToken.secret` set back is kept as is:

```js
const secret = c.type === 'auth' ? '' + c.authToken.secret : '';
app.save(c);                                   // rule changed → PocketBase issues a new secret
if (secret && '' + c.authToken.secret !== secret) { c.authToken.secret = secret; app.save(c); }
```

With this the hash was identical before, between and after both phases on the copy, and live a signed-in session
issued before the change kept reading and writing member-scoped records.

**해결:** when the `authRule` change does not change who may sign in (a key rotation, a reformatted rule), restore the
secret in the same migration. When it does narrow who may sign in, let PocketBase rotate it and sign everyone out
(OPS-204) — that is what the regeneration is for.

## OPS-485 — Google Auth Platform: a redirect URI on a new domain can be added to an existing web client by Playwright, and sign-in on that domain works minutes later in a brand-verified production project

`측정 2026-10-17 · Google Cloud console, Korean UI (Google 인증 플랫폼) · project in production with a verified brand · Brave 1.96 headed on the Air, profile copy`

**증상:** a Worker on a new domain needed its own Google sign-in. Client secrets can no longer be read back after creation, so making a new client meant capturing a new secret, and it was not known whether a redirect URI on a domain outside the brand's authorized domains would need brand re-verification.

- The edit page of an existing client is `/auth/clients/<client_id>?project=<id>`. It has the same layout as the create page: `input[formcontrolname=displayName]`, two `URI 추가` buttons (the **last** one is under 승인된 리디렉션 URI), and a `저장` button at the bottom.
- Under the name field the page says "아래에 추가한 URI의 도메인이 승인된 도메인으로 OAuth 동의 화면에 자동으로 추가됩니다." Saving added the domain with no prompt and no verification step.
- Reading the page back with `document.body.innerText` does **not** show the URIs: they live in `<input>` values. Check with `[...document.querySelectorAll('input')].map(i => i.value)`.
- About 15 minutes after saving, a real sign-in on the new domain (authorization code + PKCE, `prompt=select_account`) went through the account chooser and returned with `email_verified: true`. The consent screen showed the project's brand name, not the new site's.

**해결:** to reuse a client whose secret was saved at creation (OPS-474), add the new redirect URI on its edit page instead of creating a client: click the last `URI 추가`, type the URI with `page.keyboard`, click `저장`, then verify through input values. Expect the project's brand on the consent screen; create a separate project if the new site needs its own name there.

## OPS-486 — NJ license lookup (newjersey.mylicense.com): business licenses only on `?facility=Y`, `%` wildcards for partial names, and detail pages that time out some days

`측정 2026-10-17~18 · newjersey.mylicense.com/verification (ASP.NET WebForms) · Playwright + Brave headless on macOS`

**증상:** checking contractors' New Jersey licenses by script. A Home Improvement Contractor (`13VH…`) or other business
registration searched on `Search.aspx` finds nothing, a business-name search for `PLUMBING` returns only exact names,
and on 2026-10-17 every `Details.aspx?result=<guid>` page timed out (3 min) from two networks while the search itself
answered.

- Person licenses (Master Plumber `36BI…`, Master HVACR `19HC…`, Electrical Contractor `34EB…`) are on
  `Search.aspx`; business registrations (HIC `13VH…`, business permits) only on `Search.aspx?facility=Y`.
- The name fields match from the start; `%PLUMBING%` makes a contains-search.
- The results grid shows name, number, profession, type, status and city but **no expiry date**; that is only on the
  detail page (`Issue Date`, `Expiration Date`, `Status Change Reason`). On 2026-10-18 the same detail pages opened in
  a few seconds, so a timeout there is the site, not the client.
- NJ movers are not in this system (Public Movers licenses are at `rgbportal.dca.njoag.gov/public-view/`).

**해결:** search person and facility screens separately, use `%…%` for partial names, record status from the grid,
and retry the detail page on another day for expiry dates instead of treating a timeout as "not found". A working
form-driving script: select profession, fill `t_web_lookup__license_no` / `__full_name` / `__addr_city`, click
`sch_button`, read `a[id^="datagrid_results"][id$="_name"]` rows, open each `href` in a new page.

## OPS-487 — `CI=1 npx wrangler d1 migrations apply <db> --remote` printed nothing and applied nothing, twice; the same command run again applied the migration

`측정 2026-10-18 · npx wrangler (4.151.1 fetched by npx; no local node_modules) · macOS · Cloudflare D1`

**증상:** in a deploy chain `node scripts/build.mjs && CI=1 npx wrangler d1 migrations apply <db> --remote 2>&1 | grep -E "<name>|rror"; npx wrangler deploy`, the apply step printed no line that matched (neither the migration name nor any "error") and the deploy went ahead. `wrangler d1 migrations list <db> --remote` then still listed the migration under "Migrations to be applied", and the new Worker failed on the missing table until the migration ran. Running the same apply command again on its own printed the usual table with ✅ and applied it. It happened on two separate days in one project. Why the first call did nothing is not known.

**해결:** never trust a filtered or silent apply. After `migrations apply --remote`, run `wrangler d1 migrations list <db> --remote` and stop the deploy unless it says no migrations are pending; or apply the migration before building and deploy only after the list is empty.

## OPS-488 — US statute and rate sources from a script: leginfo.legislature.ca.gov and legiscan.com answer curl/WebFetch with a Cloudflare challenge; these official mirrors and PDFs do not

`측정 2026-10-18 · curl 8 (browser User-Agent) and WebFetch on macOS · leginfo, legiscan, CDTFA, NJCRIB, NYC, FDA, NJ Treasury`

**증상:** fetching California code sections or bill text for a fact check. `leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?...` and `.../billTextClient.xhtml?...` return HTTP 403 to WebFetch and a `<title>Just a moment...</title>` Cloudflare page to curl even with a browser User-Agent; `legiscan.com/CA/text/...` does the same. `downloads.leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/pub/...` paths return 404. Many state PDFs also come back from WebFetch as "compressed PDF data" with no readable text.

- California sales-tax statutes and regulations read in full on CDTFA's lawguides: `https://cdtfa.ca.gov/lawguides/vol1/sutl/<section>.html` (for example `6041-5.html`, `6359.html`), with the Stats./chapter history note.
- California bill analyses (Senate floor, Assembly committee) are mirrored as PDFs on `billtexts.s3.amazonaws.com/ca/ca-analysis...pdf`; search results link them. They list each operative date of the final amended version.
- NJ workers' compensation manual rates per class are in the NJCRIB rate circular PDF, fetchable by curl: Circular No. 2510 (2026-01-01 rates) is `https://www.njcrib.com/Search/ViewPDF?id=1364`; the table columns are code, rate per $100 of payroll, minimum premium, excess element.
- NYC local law text: `https://intro.nyc/local-laws/<year>-<no>` serves the certified PDF (effective-date clause and the Clerk's passed/approved dates on the last page).
- FDA Food Code 2022 (January 18, 2023 version): `https://www.fda.gov/media/164194/download`, about 5 MB.
- Census Data API needs a key; use Census Reporter instead (OPS-372).

**해결:** when WebFetch reports binary PDF data, it also saves the file under the session's `tool-results/`; copy it to a scratch directory and run `pdftotext -layout` on it, then grep. For CA code text use the CDTFA lawguides (tax) or the bill-analysis PDFs (operative dates) instead of retrying leginfo.

## OPS-489 — Telling people from crawlers in a Worker's own page-view log: a user-agent test let through about 60% non-US one-page views; Free-plan GraphQL has no `clientAsn` and the wrangler OAuth token cannot read Workers Logs, so check `request.cf.asn` and `Accept-Language` in the Worker

`측정 2026-10-18 · Cloudflare Workers Free · wrangler 4.135 OAuth token (`npx wrangler auth token`) · Astro 7 middleware on Workers`

**증상:** a site logged page views from its Worker middleware and marked bots only by a user-agent regex (bot/crawl/spider/headless/curl/…). Over 7 days, 549 visitor-days passed the test and 327 (60%) were from outside the US (SG 87, CN 37, HK 32, DE 28, KR 27, BR 22, JP 21), almost all one HTML page each, with ordinary Chrome/Safari user agents. Looking the networks up failed both ways the account offered:

- GraphQL `httpRequestsAdaptiveGroups` on a Free zone with `clientAsn` / `clientASNDescription` as dimensions: `zone '<id>' does not have access to the field 'clientasn' from the path`.
- `POST /accounts/<acct>/workers/observability/telemetry/query` with the wrangler OAuth token (observability enabled on the Worker): `{"code":10000,"message":"Authentication error"}`.
- `wrangler tail <worker> --format json` works and each event carries `request.cf.asn`, `request.cf.asOrganization` and all request headers, but a low-traffic site gave 3 requests in 30 minutes.

**해결:** decide in the Worker, where `request.cf` is always present: count a view as a bot when the user agent matches, when `Accept-Language` is missing (every browser sends it on a page load; a Chrome user agent sent without it was stored as `bot = 1` on the first try), or when `cf.asn` is a cloud network (AWS 16509/14618, Google 15169/396982, Microsoft 8075, DigitalOcean 14061, OVH 16276, Hetzner 24940, Alibaba 45102/37963, Tencent 132203/45090, Huawei 136907, Oracle 31898, Vultr 20473, Linode 63949, …) or `cf.asOrganization` names hosting. Leave Cloudflare 13335, Akamai 36183/20940 and Fastly 54113 out: iCloud Private Relay and WARP users leave through them. Counts from before the change are not comparable with counts after it. To see who is behind the numbers, run `wrangler tail` for a busy hour rather than a quiet one.

## OPS-490 — `Cache-Control: no-transform` on a Worker response stops Cloudflare Web Analytics from injecting its beacon into that page

`측정 2026-10-18 · Cloudflare Workers (custom domain) · Web Analytics with automatic setup on the zone · Brave 1.96`

**증상:** a zone with Web Analytics on "automatic setup" injects `static.cloudflareinsights.com/beacon.min.js` into every HTML response, including a private, sign-in-only console served by the Worker (`/admin`). The console's own visits were counted in the zone's analytics, and Brave logged a blocked-request console error on every console page.

**해결:** add `no-transform` to the `Cache-Control` header of the responses that should stay untouched (here `private, no-store, no-transform` on `/admin`, `/api/admin` and `/auth`). Measured on the live page: before, the HTML held the beacon script; after, a fetch of the same page has no `cloudflareinsights` string and the DOM has no beacon `<script>`. The public pages keep the beacon because their header is unchanged. No dashboard rule is needed, so this works per path from code.

## OPS-491 — Google sign-in with an unverified brand: the account chooser names the app by its redirect domain, and "앱 게시" did not need a terms-of-service URL

`측정 2026-10-18 · Google Cloud Console (Google 인증 플랫폼) · new external project, scopes openid email profile, no logo`

**증상:** a sign-in for a second product reused the OAuth client of another project, so Google's chooser showed the other product's brand name. Moving it to its own project raised two questions: what the chooser shows before brand verification, and what "앱 게시" requires.

**사실:**
- With homepage, privacy policy URL and one authorized domain filled on 브랜딩 (terms of service left empty, no logo), the 대상 page's "앱 게시" → "확인" moved the app from "테스트 중" to "프로덕션 단계" at once. This differs from OPS-084, which filled all four fields; the ToS URL was not needed here.
- The chooser then reads "계정을 선택하세요 · kyominmart.com(으)로 이동", and the consent step reads "kyominmart.com 서비스로 로그인 … kyominmart.com의 개인정보처리방침 및 서비스 약관 검토". The app name from 브랜딩 does not appear; the redirect URI's domain does. Showing the app name needs brand verification.
- The new client's secret shows once on the creation dialog; a script read it from the dialog text (`GOCSPX-…`) into a 0600 file and piped it to `wrangler secret put`, so it was never printed.

**해결:** for a sign-in used only by invited staff, the domain is a clear and accurate label, so no verification was requested. A product that wants its name on the chooser has to submit the brand for verification (domain ownership in Search Console).

## OPS-492 — Sending one email from the owner's Gmail on the Air: compose URL + the "보내기" button, in a copy of the signed-in profile when another session holds it

`측정 2026-10-18 · Brave 1.97 (Chromium 155) on the Air · playwright-core launchPersistentContext · Gmail web, Korean UI`

**증상:** a session had to send an approved outside email from the owner's Gmail. `~/kc-test/profile` was locked by another session (`SingletonLock -> air.local-<pid>`, that pid alive), so it could not be opened.

**사실:**
- `rsync -a --exclude 'Singleton*' --exclude '*Cache*' --exclude GPUCache ~/kc-test/profile/ ~/kc-test/profile-<task>/` gives a copy that opens signed in to Google while the original stays in use. The original is never touched.
- `https://mail.google.com/mail/?view=cm&fs=1&to=…&su=…&body=…` (each value `encodeURIComponent`) opens a full-screen compose with all three filled; line breaks in `body` survive as `%0A`. Wait about 8 s after `domcontentloaded`.
- The send button is `div[role="button"][data-tooltip^="보내기"]` in the Korean UI (`^="Send"` in English). One click sends; the compose window does not stay.
- Check by opening `#sent` and counting the subject text. The count can be 2 for one mail (list row plus a hidden duplicate node), so read a screenshot rather than trust the number.
- Do a dry run first (open compose, screenshot, no click) to see the From account and the text before anything leaves.

**해결:** copy the profile, dry-run, send, check Sent by screenshot, then delete the copied profile (it holds the owner's cookies).

## OPS-493 — Korean VAT: sales to US customers collected through PayPal and paid out in won are not zero-rated (영세율); a foreign-issued card or a direct USD wire is

`측정 2026-10-18 · 부가가치세법 시행 2026-01-02, 시행령 2026-02-27, 시행규칙 2026-03-20 · NTS rulings as cited`

**증상:** a Korean company selling online ads/listings to US businesses planned to collect through PayPal (Korea business account) and Payoneer, assuming the sales were 영세율 because the buyers are foreign.

**사실:**
- 영세율 for services to a 비거주자/외국법인 without a 국내사업장 (부가가치세법 제24조①3, 시행령 제33조②1) needs the money to arrive by a method in 시행규칙 제22조: foreign remittance sold to a 외국환은행, a card issued abroad, a foreign check, a foreign-currency wire into a 외화예금 with a 외화입금증명서, or offset.
- NTS ruling 서면-2016-법령해석부가-3979 (2016-07-07): receipts collected through PayPal and converted and paid to a Korean won account do not meet that test, so 10% VAT applies (about 9.09% of a price that did not include VAT). 기재부 부가가치세제과-462 (2022-10-13) denied zero rating where a domestic third party received the foreign currency and paid won, which is close to Payoneer's won payout. Payoneer USD sent by SWIFT into a 외화예금 is arguable and unsettled.
- A foreign-issued card through a Korean PG (e.g. 토스페이먼츠 overseas card acceptance) or the customer's direct USD wire qualifies. A platform selling space on its own site fits 포털 및 기타 인터넷 정보매개서비스업 (KSIC 63120, 시행령 33②1 바목), which has no reciprocity condition; 광고업 sits under 전문서비스업 and needs reciprocity.
- Stripe does not accept Korea-incorporated businesses (stripe.com/global), which is why PayPal looked like the default.

**해결:** make a foreign-card checkout or a direct USD wire the default collection channel, file 영세율 attachments (외화입금증명서 or card statements) with each VAT return, and treat PayPal won receipts as 10% taxable. Confirm Payoneer with an NTS 서면질의 before relying on it.

## OPS-494 — Google brand verification for basic scopes finished by itself in under 5 minutes, but the name shows only after a separate "브랜딩 게시" (7-day window)

`측정 2026-10-18 · Google Cloud Console (Google 인증 플랫폼) · external app in production, scopes openid email profile, no logo · Search Console domain property`

**증상:** with an unverified brand the account chooser names the app by its redirect domain (OPS-491). The question was how long brand verification takes and what it needs.

**사실:**
- Prerequisite: the authorized domain verified in Search Console. The domain property page offered an automatic Cloudflare flow; picking "모든 DNS 제공업체" shows the `google-site-verification=…` TXT value (it sits in an input, so read `input.value`, not `innerText`). A TXT record added through the Cloudflare DNS API resolved on 1.1.1.1 and 8.8.8.8 within 20 s and the property verified on the first try.
- 브랜딩 → "브랜딩 확인" shows "Verification in progress… 최대 5분이 걸릴 수 있음". Closing the browser did not stop it. Five minutes later the status read "브랜딩이 인증되었지만 아직 사용자에게 표시되고 있지 않습니다. 인증된 결과가 7일 후에 만료되기 전에 브랜딩을 게시하세요."
- Only after clicking **"브랜딩 게시"** did the status become "브랜딩이 인증되었으며 사용자에게 표시되고 있습니다". The chooser then read "계정을 선택하세요 · 교민마트(으)로 이동" and "교민마트의 개인정보처리방침 및 서비스 약관".

**해결:** verify the domain in Search Console, click "브랜딩 확인", wait about 5 minutes, then click "브랜딩 게시" before the 7 days run out. No human review was involved for this scope set.

## OPS-495 — A shared Caddyfile replaced from another project's older copy silently dropped a site block; Cloudflare answered 525 and the Worker's edge cache hid it for 14 hours

`측정 2026-10-18 · Caddy 2 on one EC2 host serving two projects' PocketBase behind Cloudflare (proxied)`

**증상:** a Worker site's article pages answered 500 while its front page still loaded. The database's public name answered `525` (SSL handshake failed) from Cloudflare. On the host PocketBase was `active` and `127.0.0.1:<port>/api/health` was 200. `/etc/caddy/Caddyfile` had no block for that name: another project's session had reloaded Caddy with a file it edited from a copy taken before the block was added (same byte size as the `.before-…` backup next to it). The front page kept working only because the Worker served it stale from its edge cache, so nothing looked down until an uncached page was opened.

**사실:**
- Caddy keeps the old certificate in its storage, so appending the block again and `systemctl reload caddy` brought the name back at once (no new ACME order).
- A missing site block on a proxied name shows as 525, not 404 or 502, because Caddy has no certificate to present for that SNI.

**해결:** on a host whose Caddyfile several projects share, append or edit your own block in place and never install a whole file from your own older copy; keep each project's block in its repo (for example `ops/<host>/Caddyfile.<project>`) so it can be put back. Watch the database's public `/api/health` from outside, not only the site's front page, since an edge-cached page hides an origin outage.

## OPS-496 — workerd refuses to start when the Worker's main module has a named export that is not a function: `Incorrect type for map entry '<NAME>'`

`측정 2026-10-18 · wrangler 4.135.0 dev (workerd local) · Workers module syntax`

**증상:** after adding `export const NEW_PER_HOUR = 8;` (and other constants) to the `main` module so tests could import them, `wrangler dev` stopped at start: `Uncaught TypeError: Incorrect type for map entry 'ATTEMPTS_PER_HOUR': the provided value is not of type 'function or ExportedHandler'` and `The Workers runtime failed to start`. Node tests that imported the same module passed, so the break showed only in the runtime. Exported functions (`export function normalizeContact`) and `export default {...}` were accepted.

**사실:** workerd treats every named export of the main module as a possible entrypoint (a handler object, a class or a function). A string, number or array there is a startup error, not a warning, and `wrangler deploy` would ship the same bundle.

**해결:** keep constants and shared helpers in a separate module (for example `src/signup.js`) and import them into the main module; tests import from that module. Run `wrangler dev` (or a deploy dry run) once after adding exports to the entry file, not only `node --test`.

## OPS-497 — Self-hosting Korean web fonts: the css2 `text=` subset comes back as one woff2 file per weight when asked with a Chrome User-Agent; 478 characters took the teaser from 471 KB of Google font traffic to about 125 KB

`측정 2026-10-18 · fonts.googleapis.com css2 · Noto Sans KR 400/700/900, Manrope 600/800 · Brave 1.96 on the Air`

**증상:** a Korean landing page loaded Noto Sans KR from Google Fonts: 20 font requests and about 471 KB of its 497 KB transfer (Lighthouse), mobile LCP spread 2.18–6.70 s over three runs, and a connection to Google that the privacy page did not mention.

**사실:**
- `https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Noto+Sans+KR:wght@400&text=<every character on the pages, URL-encoded>` with a desktop Chrome `User-Agent` answered one `@font-face` with one `format('woff2')` file (without a browser UA it answers TrueType, OPS-452). A 478-character set (pages' text plus printable ASCII, about 1.3 KB of characters, a URL near 9 KB) was accepted in one request.
- Sizes: Noto Sans KR 400 / 700 / 900 = 34.9 / 35.6 / 34.5 KB, Manrope 600 / 800 (ASCII) = 9.5 / 9.2 KB.
- Keeping the look: declare each file with a weight range (`font-weight: 600 700` on the 700 file, `800 900` on the 900 file) so `600` and `800` in the CSS still pick the same faces they did when only 400/500/700/900 were loaded.
- Characters not in the subset (a shop name someone types) fall back per glyph to the system font; nothing breaks.

**해결:** generate the subsets with a script from the pages' own characters, serve them from the site, and add a test that fails when page copy uses a character missing from the subset, so a copy edit cannot silently fall back. Remove the `fonts.googleapis.com` / `fonts.gstatic.com` links and preconnects.

## OPS-498 — A Workers custom domain answers plain `http://` with the Worker's normal response; the Worker has to redirect or refuse it itself

`측정 2026-10-18 · Workers custom domain (apex, www, plan) · run_worker_first static assets · Workers Free`

**증상:** `curl -I http://<apex>/` returned `200` with the page, and `POST http://<apex>/api/...` reached the Worker and was processed (a 400 for a bad body). No `Strict-Transport-Security` header was sent. The zone's automatic HTTPS rewrite was not in effect for these hostnames.

**해결:** check `url.protocol` first in `fetch`: `GET`/`HEAD` → `301` to the `https:` URL, anything else → `403` before reading the body, and add `Strict-Transport-Security` to HTTPS responses (start without `includeSubDomains`/preload until every subdomain is known to be HTTPS-only). Skip the check for `127.0.0.1`/`localhost` so `wrangler dev` still works. After deploying, `http://` GET answered `301 Location: https://…` and an HTTP POST answered `403` with no database work.

## OPS-499 — LADWP's news feed answers 403 only to a collector in Korea, and kera.org hides robots.txt behind a Cloudflare challenge

`측정 2026-10-18 · ladwpnews.com/feed/ · kera.org/feed/ · curl from a US Mac and from a Korean server, same bot User-Agent`

**증상:** a news collector running on a server in Korea failed every LADWP run (24/24, HTTP 403) and every KERA run (26/26). From a US machine with the same User-Agent `ladwpnews.com/feed/` returns 200; there is no other LADWP feed (`ladwp.com/rss.xml` is 404). `keranews.org` redirects to `kera.org`; `kera.org/feed/` returns 200, but `kera.org/robots.txt` and the front page return a Cloudflare challenge page (403), so the crawl policy cannot be read by a bot at all.

**해결:** do not work around it (no proxy, no UA spoofing, no headless browser). Mark such a source as paused with a reason and date, show its consecutive failures and last good fetch in the console, and only switch it back on from a fetch location the publisher allows or after asking the publisher. A 24-hour-without-success warning per source catches the next one.

## OPS-500 — Housing and second-hand listing sites mostly forbid reposting; official affordable-housing lottery notices are the usable source

`측정 2026-10-18 · terms pages read on the sites themselves · NJ, LA, Dallas, Denver, Atlanta`

**증상:** looking for listings a community site may repost with a link. Terms that forbid it outright: NJ Housing Resource Center / MyHousingSearch family (njhousing.gov, georgiahousingsearch.org, coloradohousingsearch, housing.lacounty.gov: "copying … for other than personal, noncommercial use is expressly prohibited"), Access Housing LA ("Unauthorized copying, reproduction, republishing … posting … is prohibited"), GovDeals ("may not … reproduce … any Listing Data"), Public Surplus (even manual copying), Freecycle, Buy Nothing, Karrot. Dallas Housing Authority reserves all rights and asks for a permission request. Irvine allows non-commercial, non-profit use only. Bergen County's Housing Navigator asks to be told when linked.

**해결:** usable without asking: NJ affordable-unit lottery notices published by the towns' administrative agents (e.g. Piazza & Associates property pages, required UHAC marketing, no reposting clause) and housing-authority waitlist announcements (DeKalb, Denver Housing Authority) — restate the facts in your own words, link the original, keep a check date and an end date. Piazza's rent and income tables are rendered by script: plain `curl` shows the headings only; read them in a real browser. For used goods there is no permitted outside source; supply has to come from members or consenting sellers.

## OPS-501 — Reading US landlord-tenant law from a script: leginfo opens in a real browser, the Texas statutes site is a script-rendered shell, and search summaries of Colorado HB25-1249 state a cap the enacted text dropped

`측정 2026-10-18 · Brave 1.96 via Playwright (headed) on the test MacBook · curl 8 · CA, TX, CO, NJ, GA official sources`

**증상:** checking state security-deposit and tenant-screening rules for a site's copy. (1) `leginfo.legislature.ca.gov` answers curl and WebFetch with a Cloudflare challenge (OPS-488). (2) `statutes.capitol.texas.gov/Docs/PR/htm/PR.92.htm` answers curl with HTTP 200 but the body is an Angular shell with no statute text, so a grep for `Sec. 92.103.` finds nothing. (3) A web search for Colorado HB25-1249 returned summaries saying it lowered the deposit cap from two months' rent to one from 2026-01-01; the introduced draft did, but the enrolled text (`content.leg.colorado.gov/sites/default/files/documents/2025A/bills/2025a_1249_enr.pdf`) only amends 38-12-102(4) and 38-12-103 (30-day default return, at most 60). The two-month cap in 38-12-102.5 is unchanged.

**해결:** open leginfo and the Texas statutes page in Brave with Playwright (`headless: false`, `waitUntil: 'networkidle'`, then a few seconds) and read `document.body.innerText`; both load normally there (CA 1950.5 showed "Amended by Stats. 2025, Ch. 340 (AB 414)"). For claims about what a bill changed, read the enrolled or signed text, not the introduced draft or a search summary. Sources that `curl` reads directly: CA DRE tenant guide PDF (`dre.ca.gov/publications/ResourceGuidebook/2026_Landlord_Tenant_Guide.pdf`), CA courts self-help, NJ DCA "Truth in Renting" PDF, NJ DCR Fair Chance in Housing page, Texas AG renters' rights, Colorado Legislative Council "Renters' Rights" summary PDF, Colorado DRE bill summaries, Georgia DCA landlord-tenant handbook. Run each PDF through `pdftotext -layout` and grep.

## OPS-502 — Playwright WebKit (Safari engine): a page that calls `navigator.serviceWorker.register()` on load stops answering; register on the user's action instead

`측정 2026-10-18 · Playwright WebKit 2370 (playwright-core) on macOS, MacBook Air M1 · Astro 7 site on Workers`

**증상:** in WebKit only, every page of one kind (the edition pages) stopped answering a few seconds after load:
`page.evaluate(() => document.readyState)` never returned (10 s timeout), `page.goto(…, {waitUntil: 'load'})` timed out,
clicks waited forever. Chromium (Brave) was fine at every width, and the Air's load average was 1.7, so it was not load.
Blocking Turnstile and every third-party host changed nothing; turning JavaScript off made it answer. Removing the page's
inline scripts one at a time (fetch the HTML, `route.fulfill` it without script k) found the one: the push-alert box,
which ran `navigator.serviceWorker.register('/sw.js').then(() => navigator.serviceWorker.ready)` on every load.

**해결:** on load only ask for an existing registration (`navigator.serviceWorker.getRegistration('/')`, then its
`pushManager.getSubscription()`) and register when the reader turns the alert on. The same pages then answered in
WebKit at 390, 768 and 1440 px, light and dark, on production. A test that stubs push must stub
`ServiceWorkerContainer.prototype.getRegistration` too. Separately, WebKit's `load` event never came on pages with the
Cloudflare Web Analytics beacon and Turnstile, so wait for `commit` plus a few seconds rather than `load`. Whether
Safari on a device behaves the same was not measured.

## OPS-503 — Apple Developer Program organization enrollment (Korea): the D-U-N-S profile fills the entity fields, the work email is verified by a 6-character code that a Cloudflare Email Routing address delivers to Gmail fine

`측정 2026-10-18 · developer.apple.com/enroll (ko UI) · Brave 155 on the MacBook Air · Cloudflare Email Routing`

**증상:** opening `https://developer.apple.com/enroll/` while signed in resumed an organization enrollment at
`/enroll/organization/details/edit/signing-authority`, titled 「추가 정보가 필요합니다.」 법인명, D-U-N-S 번호, 현지 사업자명,
사업자등록번호, address and 지역 were already filled read-only from the D&B record ("이 정보가 잘못된 경우 D&B 프로파일을
업데이트해 주십시오"). Still empty: 웹사이트, 전화번호 (국제 코드 select + number + 내선), the 서명 권한 radio
(`signingRole`: 「대표/설립자로서…」 or 「…권한을 부여받았습니다」) and 직장 이메일 (`emailAddress`, must be on the
organization's domain).

**사실:**
- 「코드 전송」 sends mail from Apple Developer with the subject "Action required: Please verify your work email
  address." The code is 6 characters, letters and digits, case-sensitive (e.g. `CL2OZL`), and expires in 10 minutes.
  It goes into `workEmailOTP` on the same page.
- A `contact@<domain>` address on Cloudflare Email Routing forwarding to Gmail received it within a minute; a session
  can read the code itself in Gmail on the Air. No mailbox on the domain is needed.
- The Apple account used was a member of another company's team whose membership had expired. That did not block
  enrolling a new organization with the same account.
- After 「계속」 the page `/enroll/organization/details/confirm` shows 「등록 신청을 처리하는 중입니다.」, an 등록 ID and
  「법적 계약 서명 권한이 확인되면 등록을 완료하는 방법을 이메일로 안내해 드립니다.」 The agreement and the annual fee come
  only after that email, not in the same session.
- The Air's traffic leaves through a US exit node (OPS-275); the country stayed KR because it comes from the
  D&B record, not from the IP.

**해결:** have the D-U-N-S ready before starting (the entity fields cannot be typed in), use a domain address that
forwards to a mailbox the session can read, and expect a wait for Apple's signing-authority check before payment.

## OPS-504 — OPS-276 also happens with Brave: starting the Brave binary with `--user-data-dir=<Playwright profile>` to drive it over CDP wiped every google.com cookie; copying the `Cookies` file back from a Playwright-made copy restores the sign-in

`측정 2026-10-18 · Brave 155.1.97.59 · playwright-core 1.63 · macOS on the MacBook Air · ~/kc-test/profile`

**증상:** to keep one interactive window open across many steps, the Brave binary was started directly with
`--user-data-dir=$HOME/kc-test/profile --remote-debugging-port=<port>` and each step attached with
`chromium.connectOverCDP`. Gmail in that window went to the Google sign-in page. The profile's `Cookies` DB then held
0 rows for `%google.com`, while copies of the same profile made earlier the same day still had `SID`.

**원인:** the same as OPS-276. A plain launch uses the real macOS Keychain key, Playwright launches use
`--use-mock-keychain`, and each discards the cookies it cannot decrypt. Brave behaves like Chrome here. Attaching over
CDP does not change which key the browser was started with.

**해결:** never start a Playwright profile with the plain browser binary, including for CDP. If it already happened:
stop that browser, back up `Default/Cookies`, delete `Default/Cookies-journal`, and copy `Default/Cookies` from a copy
of the profile that Playwright wrote (here `~/kc-test/km/profile-km`, last written the same morning). The next
`open()` from `~/kc-test/kc-browser.mjs` showed `myaccount.google.com` signed in. Sign-ins done in the plain window
(here an Apple account) are lost by that restore.

## OPS-505 — A Play Store emulator image with no Google account accepts Chrome's PWA install sheet but never mints the WebAPK: use it to test the install card, not the hand-off to the app

`측정 2026-10-18 · Android emulator, system-images;android-35;google_apis_playstore;arm64-v8a (no account) · Chrome 124.0.6367.219 · adb 1.0.41`

**증상:** with no phone on USB, a session tried to check a PWA's install-then-open flow (OPS-284) on the main Mac's Play Store AVD. Chrome fired `beforeinstallprompt` after one swipe on the page, the page's own install button opened Chrome's sheet (`Install app` / `Install`, buttons `com.android.chrome:id/positive_button`), and after `Install` a toast said "Installing <name>…". 43 s later `pm list packages | grep webapk` was still empty, `topResumedActivity` stayed `ChromeTabbedActivity`, `getInstalledRelatedApps()` never returned the app, and every `intent://<host>/…` only reloaded the tab. Logcat showed Finsky busy with an auto-update of WebView and no WebAPK install. A WebAPK is minted through Play, and Play has no account here.

To get there headless: write `chrome --disable-fre --no-default-browser-check --no-first-run` to `/data/local/tmp/chrome-command-line` and `am set-debug-app --persistent com.android.chrome`; Chrome 124 still shows a "Chrome notifications make things easier" dialog on the first page (tap "No thanks").

**해결:** an account-less emulator verifies the page side only: the offer, Chrome's sheet, the installing state, and the fallback when the app never lands. The hand-off to the opened app needs a phone (or an AVD) signed in to Play. Pages that wait for `getInstalledRelatedApps()` should give up without sending the intent when it never sees the app; otherwise the reader gets three reloads (the OPS-284 retry loop) for nothing.

## OPS-506 — A deploy script that installs its repo's whole Caddyfile on a shared host drops other projects' site blocks on every run: merge the foreign blocks in before installing

`측정 2026-10-18 · Caddy 2 on one EC2 host shared by two projects · bash deploy script over ssh`

**증상:** the 525 outage in OPS-495 came back the same day. No session had restored a backup: one project's deploy script copied `ops/<host>/Caddyfile` from its repo and ran `install -m 644 … /etc/caddy/Caddyfile && systemctl reload caddy` whenever the two files differed. The repo copy held only that project's sites, so each deploy removed the block the other project had appended. The stage copy's mtime on the host (`~/<stage>/Caddyfile`, 21:05:40 UTC) matched the outage to the minute.

**사실:**
- "Edit in place" (OPS-495) does not protect a block from a script that rewrites the whole file. Grep every repo that deploys to the host for `/etc/caddy/Caddyfile`.
- `caddy fmt` output puts each top-level block's address line at column 0 ending in `{` and its closing `}` alone at column 0, so awk can split blocks without parsing Caddyfile syntax.

**해결:** before `caddy validate` and `install`, append every top-level block from the live file whose address line the repo file does not have:

```sh
awk 'NR==FNR { if (/^[^ \t#{}].*\{$/) ours[$0]=1; next }
  /^[^ \t#{}].*\{$/ && !($0 in ours) { keep=1; print "" }
  keep { print } keep && /^\}$/ { keep=0 }' stage/Caddyfile /etc/caddy/Caddyfile > stage/Caddyfile.others
cat stage/Caddyfile.others >> stage/Caddyfile
```

The global options block (`{` at column 0) is skipped, and the repo's own sites still win. A dry run on the host gave a file byte-identical to the live one, so the existing `cmp` check skips the reload. Comment lines at column 0 just above a foreign block are not carried over, so keep comments inside the block.

## OPS-508 — iOS 27 Safari "Add to Home Screen" is five taps behind the page menu, and Safari's user agent says iOS 18_7: read `Version/` to pick the steps

`측정 2026-10-18 · Xcode 27.0 iOS 27.0 simulator (iPhone 18 Pro, iPad mini A17 Pro), Korean UI · XCUITest accessibility tree`

**증상:** an install guide written for iOS 18 (bottom-centre Share) or iOS 26 (bottom-right `···`) points at buttons that are not there on iOS 27. Measured iOS 27 compact layout (the default) on iPhone, accessibility identifiers in brackets:
- bottom bar: `뒤로` (`BackButton`), the page menu `페이지 메뉴` (`MoreMenuButton`, a ≡ icon at the **left inside the address pill**, centre x 114 of 402 pt), the address, `탭` (`TabOverviewButton`, bottom right, where `···` was on iOS 26);
- page menu → first item `공유` → share sheet with an app row and an action row `복사 · 북마크에 추가 · 읽기 목록에 추가 · 더 보기(⌄)`; **`홈 화면에 추가` is only in the list under `더 보기`** (cell identifier `actionGroupCell`);
- the add sheet: name from the manifest `short_name`, URL = manifest `start_url`, `웹 앱으로 열기` switch on by default, blue `추가` top right. After `추가` iOS goes to the home screen with the new icon; the icon opens `start_url` standalone (`navigator.standalone === true`), with a blank white screen for about 2 s.
- iPad (iPadOS 27): `공유` (`ShareButton`) in the top toolbar, centre x 624 of 744 pt, opens the same sheet as a popover, again with `더 보기` before `홈 화면에 추가`.

Safari's UA on iOS 27 is `… iPhone OS 18_7 like Mac OS X … Version/27.0 Mobile/15E148 Safari/604.1`: the OS part is frozen since iOS 26, so `/OS (\d+)_/` gives 18 and picks the old layout.

**해결:** choose the layout from `/Version\/(\d+)/` (27 → page-menu steps, 26 → `···` steps, ≤18 → bottom Share), iPad by `iPad` in the UA or `MacIntel` with touch points, and other iOS browsers (`CriOS|FxiOS|EdgiOS`) by name. To check a guide against real Safari without a device: a UI-test bundle (OPS-239) whose steps tap by label or identifier (`MoreMenuButton`, `공유`, the share sheet's `더 보기` by coordinate, `cells[identifier=actionGroupCell][label=홈 화면에 추가]`, navigation-bar `추가`), then `XCUIApplication(bundleIdentifier: "com.apple.springboard")` to tap the new icon. Tapping by plain label can hit the page's own text with the same words behind the sheet; match the cell identifier.

**Follow-up (same day, real device):** iPadOS 26.7.1 Safari on an iPad mini 5 (USB) has the same path: `공유` (`ShareButton`, top toolbar, x 882 of 1024 pt in landscape) → popover → `더 보기` (cell `actionGroupCell`) → `홈 화면에 추가` → `추가`, then the icon opens the site standalone. So the `더 보기` step is already there on 26, not new in 27. Driven by the same UI-test bundle signed with the Personal Team and re-using the bundle id of the runner already on the device (OPS-370's three-app limit); this run needed no Touch ID prompt (OPS-374). Screens came back as `XCTAttachment`s through `-resultBundlePath` and `xcresulttool export attachments`; landscape screenshots are stored rotated.

## OPS-507 — (무효 — OPS-506과 중복) shared Caddyfile overwritten by another project's deploy script

`측정 2026-10-18`

Written the same minute as OPS-506 by another session; see OPS-506. Symptom seen from the dropped site's side: its database host answered Cloudflare 525 while every other host on the same Caddy answered 200, and only the pages that read the database returned 500.

## OPS-509 — `pmset sleepnow` on a Mac kept awake for lid-closed use fails with `error 0xe00002e2` even as root; with `disablesleep 0` a `caffeinate -s` turns it into a running DarkWake

`측정 2026-10-19 · M1 MacBook Air (MacBookAir10,1), macOS 27.0.1, on AC, lid closed · waker: Mac mini on the same Wi-Fi LAN`

**증상:** `pmset sleepnow` printed `Unable to sleep system: error 0xe00002e2` (rc 71), as the user and with `sudo`. `pmset -g` shows `SleepDisabled 1` near the top ("System-wide power settings"), which `pmset -g custom` does not list. After `sudo pmset disablesleep 0` the value flipped back to 1 within 10 s: a root LaunchDaemon (`StartInterval 10`) ran `pmset -a disablesleep 1` whenever `pmset -g ps` said "AC Power", so the Mac could run with its lid closed. `grep -l disablesleep /Library/LaunchDaemons/*.plist` finds nothing when the plist only names a script; read each daemon's `ProgramArguments`.

With `disablesleep 0` but a `caffeinate -ims` LaunchAgent alive, `sleepnow` prints `Sleeping now...` yet `pmset -g log` shows `Entering DarkWake state due to 'Software Sleep'`: the display turns off and every process keeps running. The kernel log (`log show --predicate 'process == "kernel" AND eventMessage CONTAINS "PMRD"'`) names the blocker: `System sleep prevented by kPMUserDisabledAllSleep` or `kPMCPUAssertion`; `pmset -g log` does not.

With both out of the way the Mac sleeps (`Entering Sleep state due to 'Software Sleep'`), but on Wi-Fi it DarkWakes every 10–15 s on received packets (7 DarkWakes in 80 s). Its own Cloudflare tunnel reconnects inside those windows, so an ssh through the tunnel can reach a "sleeping" Mac; anything that ssh runs (e.g. `caffeinate -u`) then fully wakes it — a status check must not run it.

**해결:** To sleep remotely: have the enforcing daemon skip while a fresh request file exists (`find <file> -mmin -10` → want 0, so a lost wake cannot leave lid-closed protection off for good), `sudo pmset disablesleep 0` (sudoers: `NOPASSWD: /usr/bin/pmset`), `launchctl bootout gui/$UID/<caffeinate agent>`, then `sudo pmset sleepnow`. On wake run `caffeinate -u -t 2`, delete the request file, `pmset disablesleep 1`, `launchctl bootstrap` the agent. Measured: slept 09:57:16, the LAN peer's magic packet + ssh (OPS-432) gave full wake at 09:58:23, 2 s after it started; through the tunnel 3 s. Set `sudo pmset schedule wake` as a fallback while testing.

## OPS-510 — Cloudflare Registrar: a new registration cannot move to another Cloudflare account for 10 days, and cannot point its nameservers away; a zone routes only to its own account's Workers

`측정 2026-10-19 · Cloudflare Registrar (.com registered the same day) · dashboard in Brave 155 (ko UI) · Workers Free`

**증상:** the owner bought a domain in the shared account and then wanted it in a separate account (so its Workers
Free limits — 100,000 requests a day, 5 crons, D1 rows read, KV writes — are its own; they are per account, not per
domain). Registrar → 도메인 → 설정 → 「다른 Cloudflare 계정으로 이동」 was disabled: 「도메인이 최근 10일 이내에 등록되어
이전 대상이 아닙니다」. The domain's DNS 설정 page offers no custom nameservers, so the zone added to the new account (it
gets its own pair, e.g. alina/yadiel) stays `pending`. A Workers custom domain or route needs the zone in the Worker's
own account, and a proxied CNAME to another account's hostname is error 1014.

- A second account under the same login: account switcher → 「+ 계정 만들기」, name only, no payment (free user).
- The move's other prerequisites (official doc "Move a Cloudflare Registrar domain registration between accounts"):
  the domain added as a site in the target account with a plan, DNSSEC off, both accounts approve, then 30 days locked.

**해결:** add the zone to the target account at once and put every DNS record, WAF rule and zone setting there while
it is pending (records, rulesets and settings are accepted on a pending zone; Email Routing `enable` is not:
`2009 Active zone required`, so copy its MX/SPF/DKIM records by hand). Serve the site meanwhile with a small proxy
Worker in the old account on the custom domains that `fetch`es the new account's `*.workers.dev` with a shared secret
header plus the reader's `CF-Connecting-IP`/`CF-IPCountry`; the real Worker turns those back into the request (and
redirects any workers.dev visitor without the secret to the public host). Move the registration on day 10.

## OPS-511 — D1 export API refuses a database that has an FTS5 table: "cannot export databases with virtual tables (like FTS5)"

`측정 2026-10-19 · D1 REST POST /accounts/:a/d1/database/:id/export {"output_format":"polling"} · database with one FTS5 table`

**증상:** a daily off-site backup job got `D1 Export error: cannot export databases with virtual tables (like FTS5)`
on the first call. `wrangler d1 export` uses the same API. Time Travel still works (7 days on Workers Free).

**해결:** read the tables yourself: `SELECT type, name, sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE sql IS NOT NULL` (skip the FTS
table and its shadow tables `<name>_data/_idx/_docsize/_config/_content`, `_cf_*`, `sqlite_*`), then each table
`SELECT * … ORDER BY rowid LIMIT 200 OFFSET ?` through `/query`, written as JSON lines + gzip (6,768 rows, 23 MB
database → 4.7 MB in 9 s). Restore = run the schema, insert rows (one row per statement, 20 per batch: D1 binds at most
100 parameters), rebuild the FTS table from its source columns, compare `COUNT(*)` per table. Rehearsed into a scratch
database: every count equal.

## OPS-512 — Korean substring search on D1 without a full scan: FTS5 over overlapping character pairs, queried as a phrase

`측정 2026-10-19 · D1 (Workers Free, 5 M rows read a day per account) · 2,945 Korean news articles`

**증상:** `WHERE search LIKE '%네일샵%'` reads every row (`rows_read` 2,945 per query). A question box that probes 8
keywords in title and body is 16 such queries per question, about 47,000 rows; a few hundred questions a day reach
the account's daily row budget. FTS5's `unicode61` tokenizer indexes whole words, and Korean compounds have no spaces
(네일샵, 소상공인지원금), so a word index misses 네일 inside 네일샵; `trigram` cannot find two-syllable words.

**해결:** index each run of letters/digits as its overlapping pairs (`네일샵` → `네일 일샵`, `LG전자` → `lg g전 전자`) with a
3-letter separator token between words (`qqq`, never equal to a queried pair), and query a word as the phrase of its
pairs: `body : "네일 일샵"`. Consecutive pairs only match where the text contains the word. Measured against `LIKE`:
네일샵 5/5 rows (rows read 5 vs 2,945), 프랜차이즈 128/128 (128), hyundai 17/17 (17). One-letter words fall back to LIKE.
Also: page lists by fetching `perPage + 1` rows instead of `COUNT(*)`, which reads every match.

## OPS-513 — Workers KV on the free plan (1,000 writes a day): put many images in one value and serve byte ranges

`측정 2026-10-19 · Workers KV bulk API PUT /storage/kv/namespaces/:id/bulk · Workers Free · 3,790 images, 540 MB`

**증상:** a new Cloudflare account has no R2 until a payment method is added (R2 "구독 추가" opens a card/PayPal form,
even for the $0 tier; the API answers `10042 Please enable R2 through the Cloudflare Dashboard`). KV is free (1 GB) but
allows 1,000 writes a day, so one key per image (and per thumbnail width) would take days.

**해결:** pack images (original + widths) into values of up to 4 MB and keep `{width: [offset, length, type?]}` per
image in the database; the Worker reads the value with `cacheTtl`, `slice`s the range and caches the response a year.
3,790 images and their thumbnails became 132 keys, uploaded by the bulk API in 14 requests of about 45 MB (base64);
`successful_key_count` per request. PNG photos stored as lossless WebP: 287 MB → 149 MB, same pixels. New uploads get
their own key; widths are made in the browser with canvas before upload (a Worker cannot resize on the free plan).

## OPS-514 — Resend: a key restricted to a deleted domain still answers 200 on /emails/batch, and the mail stays "Queued" forever

`측정 2026-10-19 · Resend free plan (3 domains) · API key with Sending access restricted to one domain`

**증상:** the free plan refused a fourth domain (「You have reached the domain limit of your plan」), so the old staging
domain was deleted and the new one added and verified. The site's sign-in mail from the new domain then showed
`Queued` in Resend's Emails list with no events, for 30 minutes, while `POST /emails/batch` had returned 200 to the
Worker. A direct `POST /emails` with the same key named the cause: `400 The associated domain with your API key is not
verified. Please, create a new API key with full access or with a verified domain.` The key was restricted to the
deleted domain.

**해결:** after deleting or replacing a Resend domain, create a new key (Sending access, the new domain) and replace the
secret; delete the old key. Test a new sender with single `POST /emails` (it reports the error), not `/emails/batch`.
Non-ASCII display names (`뉴욕경제신문 <news@…>`) are fine.

## OPS-515 — Cloudflare dashboard session API: writes from page `fetch` are blocked even with `x-atok`; create an account-owned token from the "Write all resources" template instead

`측정 2026-10-19 · dash.cloudflare.com in Brave 155 (Playwright persistent profile) · new free account`

**증상:** `GET /api/v4/...` from a signed-in dashboard tab worked (OPS-301), but every write — `POST /zones`, `POST
/accounts`, `PATCH /zones/:id/settings/…`, `PUT /registrar/domains/…` — returned Cloudflare's HTML "Sorry, you have
been blocked" page (403), also with the `x-atok` value from `/api/v4/system/bootstrap` (`result.data.atok`) that the
dashboard sends. The same writes done by clicking in the UI went through. The wrangler OAuth token covers only the
accounts that existed when it was granted (a new account answers `10000 Authentication error`).

**해결:** in the new account: 계정 관리 → 계정 API 토큰 → 토큰 생성 → template 「Write all resources」 (172 permissions, scoped
to that account only) → 토큰 검토 → 토큰 생성. The result page shows the token once (plus R2 S3 keys derived from it);
read it from the page text right after 「귀하의 API 토큰」 and save it 0600. That token can then create narrower tokens
(`POST /accounts/:a/tokens`) and roll itself (`PUT /accounts/:a/tokens/:id/value`).

## OPS-516 — Turnstile in Playwright: drop `--enable-automation`, then click the checkbox iframe by its position

`측정 2026-10-19 · Turnstile managed widget, appearance interaction-only · Brave 155 via Playwright, headed and headless`

**증상:** with Playwright's default launch the widget showed 「사람인지 확인하십시오」 and never passed; clicking
`input[type=checkbox]` inside the challenge frame found nothing (closed shadow root). Headless failed the same way.

**해결:** launch with `ignoreDefaultArgs: ['--enable-automation'], args: ['--disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled']`,
headed, and click with the mouse at the frame element's box (`frame.frameElement().boundingBox()`, x + 30, mid
height). The check passed and the site's own request went through (question answered in 37 s including the model).
For the product: give the silent check about 12 s and extend the wait only from `before-interactive-callback`; a
failed check with no token should not be retried, or the reader waits twice.

## OPS-517 — Dokploy raw compose with a script baked in by `dockerfile_inline` heredoc: double every `$`, and dokploy.mnori.com runs on nj1

`측정 2026-10-19 · Dokploy on dokploy.mnori.com · docker compose v2 · node:22-alpine`

**증상:** a backup job was shipped as `build.dockerfile_inline` with `RUN cat > /app/job.mjs <<'EOF' … EOF` (so a
change to the script rebuilds and replaces the container, unlike inline `configs:`, OPS-243). The deploy failed with
`invalid interpolation format for services.backup.build.dockerfile_inline` after warnings such as `The "DATA" variable
is not set`: compose interpolates `${…}` inside `dockerfile_inline` before Docker sees the quoted heredoc. Separately,
the deploy landed on nj1, not misa: the panel moved to nj1 on 2026-10-12 although the local key file is still
`~/.config/dokploy/misa.key`; `/etc/dokploy/compose/<appName>` and `/etc/dokploy/logs/<appName>` are on nj1.

**해결:** generate the compose from the script and replace `$` with `$$` (JS: `script.replace(/\$/g, '$$$$')`); add
`USER 1000:1000` and bind-mount a folder in the user's home. Look for the deployment log on nj1. `compose.one` still
shows the previous deployment's status for a while (OPS-337); read the log file instead.

## OPS-518 — Node 26 native fetch silently replaces a supplied Host header during a loopback virtual-host rehearsal

`측정 2026-10-19 · Node v26.8.2 · Playwright 1.63.0 · MacBook Air M1`

**증상:** `fetch('http://127.0.0.1:<port>/path', {headers: {host: 'site.example'}})` returned the default site's HTML instead of the host-conditioned rewrite. The request succeeded, so a routing test looked like an application failure. A local HTTP echo server confirmed the received Host was `127.0.0.1:<port>`, not the supplied value. The same request through Playwright `APIRequestContext.get` delivered `site.example`; `curl -H 'Host: site.example'` also reached the expected route. This was measured on Node 26.8.2, not asserted for every Node/Undici version.

**해결:** use `request.newContext().get(loopbackUrl, {headers: {host}, maxRedirects: 0})` for virtual-host tests, or a verified HTTP client that sends Host. Inspect the received header with a local echo server before interpreting a successful HTTP response as evidence for the intended virtual host. Do not silently change application routing to satisfy the default-host response.

## OPS-519 — A fulfilled redirect can escape a Playwright hostname-to-loopback rehearsal

`측정 2026-10-19 · Playwright 1.63.0 · Brave 155 · MacBook Air M1`

**증상:** a browser context mapped real HTTPS hostnames to an isolated HTTP app with `context.route`, `context.request.fetch(..., {maxRedirects: 0})`, and `route.fulfill({response})`. When the local response was 307 to another real hostname, the destination document came from the old public site instead of the loopback app. Its actual header DOM contained the old links, while an explicit loopback request returned the new links. `maxRedirects: 0` controls the API request, not the browser's follow-up to the fulfilled response. The installed Playwright type documentation warns that the routing handler is only called for the first URL when the response redirects. OPS-272's recommendation to pass the 3xx through is therefore insufficient as an isolation guarantee in this setup; its existing entry is left unchanged.

**해결:** in a closed host rehearsal, inspect status and Location through the loopback API without following, assert an exact destination allowlist, then open that destination as a separate intercepted browser navigation. Abort and fail on unexpected 3xx responses inside the route handler. This tests the redirect contract and destination page without letting the browser follow a real-host redirect outside the local mapping. Preserve the failed run as a harness failure, not a product regression.

## OPS-520 — macOS: Bluetooth music stutters right after each Handoff advertising burst; turn off Handoff *sending* only

`측정 2026-10-19 · macOS 27.0.1 · MacBook Pro M1 Max (BCM4387) · third-party headset over A2DP SBC bitpool 37 · BLE mouse and keyboard connected`

**증상:** music on a Bluetooth headset dropped out for a moment every few minutes, and the link fell once with
`Received disconnection indication on device <name> reason 431` after `ReTx = 57%`. RSSI was strong (-44 dBm median),
so distance was not the cause. Each dropout is logged by bluetoothd as `A2DP packet flushed: L2CAP (chip) flush occured`
or `A2DP packet flushed: Audio Queue full`. Per-second health is in `A2DP LinkQualityReport: … ReTx = …% … for <n> ch`
(n = AFH channels in use; 20 is the floor).

Over 3 h (4,379 streaming seconds, 367 flushes), joined per second against other bluetoothd/identityservicesd lines:

- In the 0-3 s after `identityservicesd … Continuity start advertising … type 12 … (30.00 ms)` (Handoff, Apple type 0x0C;
  it fires on every app/tab activity change, about once a minute) the flush rate was 342/1000 s with the mouse idle and
  575 with it moving, against 15-27 at any other time. About 75 % of all flushes fell in those windows.
- Seconds with AFH at 20 channels: 183 flushes/1000 s, against 14 with more channels.
- A BLE mouse that bluetoothd logs as `Device "<name>" is Incompatible LE HID` stays at a 7.5 ms connection interval while
  audio streams (compatible HIDs are moved off it); moving it roughly doubled the flush rate.

**해결:** turn off Handoff sending only; receiving (and so pasting from an iPhone's Universal Clipboard) keeps working:
`defaults -currentHost write com.apple.coreservices.useractivityd ActivityAdvertisingAllowed -bool false; killall useractivityd`.
In the next 11 min there were 0 type-12 bursts. Flushes did not go to 0: 40 of the 46 left came in one 90 s stretch with
AFH at 20 channels and RSSI at -55 to -61 dBm; the following 5 min had none. The Settings toggle (General → AirDrop &
Handoff) turns off both directions. A 5-minute LaunchAgent that re-applies the key and logs flush count, ReTx median,
AFH-20 share and burst count is a cheap way to see a relapse; `log show --last 5m` with a narrow predicate ran in 1.5 s.

## OPS-521 — VoiceOver AppleScript cursor reads and announcement text are different observations

`측정 2026-10-19 · macOS 27.0.1 · Brave 155.1.97.59 · headed browser, Korean UI, remote AppleScript`

**증상:** a native screen-reader harness falsely rejected an accessible dialog because
`text under cursor of keyboard cursor` returned a generic actionless-button label
and `content of last phrase` was empty. In the same observation,
`text under cursor of vo cursor` returned the correct game title, item count and
dialog role. Conversely, after a timed live-region update, the keyboard and
VoiceOver cursors still named the focused cancel button while `last phrase`
contained the complete new error message. An initial offline description was
not included in the first dialog announcement, but moving the VoiceOver cursor
one item left read its complete text.

**해결:** collect all three native observations, retaining empty or `missing value`
results instead of treating one property as the entire screen-reader output:
`tell application "VoiceOver" to get {text under cursor of vo cursor, content of last phrase, text under cursor of keyboard cursor}`.
For static descriptions, exercise actual VoiceOver traversal as well, for example
`tell application "VoiceOver" to tell vo cursor to move left`.
Distinguish automatic announcements from content reached by navigation; a readable
description does not prove it was automatically announced. Preserve failed harness
expectations and explain their correction. Keep the test browser frontmost, mute
the system before starting VoiceOver, and restore sound/scripting preferences
afterward. This requires working native accessibility access and does not bypass
the locked-console limitation in OPS-363.

## OPS-522 — A new Cloudflare account has no card, so Zero Trust's $0 plan stops at checkout; and the first minute after "계정 생성" the dashboard renders blank pages

`측정 2026-10-19 · dash.cloudflare.com (ko UI) in Brave 155 via Playwright (headed, signed-in profile copy) · account created the same minute, Free plan`

**증상:** two things on a freshly created second account under the same login:

- Zero Trust → 시작하기 → 「Zero Trust 무료」 요금제 선택 led to `/zero-trust/checkout/payment` with Apple Pay, Google Pay,
  PayPal, card or bank fields, a billing address and two terms checkboxes. OPS-428 passed the same screen only because
  that account already had a card on file. A new account never inherits one ("다른 계정의 기존 결제 수단 … 을
  상속받지 않습니다" on the create dialog), so every Access feature — including the workers.dev "Cloudflare Access"
  toggle — needs the owner's card first. A session cannot do this step.
- Right after 「계정 생성」 a modal 「계정을 사용자와 연결 중…」 spun; navigating away left `/{account}/api-tokens` with an
  empty main area for about two minutes. The page's own calls `GET /accounts/{id}` and `/access/organizations` answered
  403 while `/memberships` already listed the account as `accepted`. A new tab two minutes later rendered normally.
  The account API token page now offers a template 「Full account and zone access」 next to 「Write all resources」.

**해결:** plan Access only for accounts with a payment method; for a private preview without one, gate in the Worker
(a key sent once in the URL fragment, a cookie holding its digest; see OPS-524 for what such a gate misses). After
creating an account, wait until `GET /accounts/{id}` answers 200 from the dashboard session before driving its pages.

`측정 2026-10-19 · resend.com dashboard (Google sign-in) · free plan with three verified domains`

**증상:** 「Add domain」 on an account with three verified domains opened 「Upgrade to add new domains — You have reached the
domain limit of your plan」 (Pro $20/month, 10 domains). OPS-355 found a second domain accepted on the free plan; the

## OPS-524 — Workers static assets are served before the Worker runs: an Astro middleware gate on workers.dev leaves every `public/` file reachable

`측정 2026-10-19 · Astro 7.3.3 · @astrojs/cloudflare 14.3.2 · wrangler 4.135.0 deploy (dist/server/wrangler.json, assets.directory ../client) · workers.dev`

**증상:** a private preview put every page behind an Astro middleware (closed page unless a cookie). Pages, API and
`/__preview` were gated, but `/fonts/*.woff2`, `/images/*` and an untracked `public/concepts/` folder of design-review
HTML boards from another session (`/concepts/index.html`, 7.5 MB) answered 200 to anyone: requests that match a static
asset never reach the Worker, so middleware cannot see them. `/_headers` in `public/` is consumed (404) and its rules
applied (`Parsed 3 valid header rules` in `astro preview`).

**해결:** treat everything in `public/` as public. Remove what must not ship from `dist/client` between build and deploy
(here `rmSync("dist/client/concepts")` in the deploy script) or move it out of `public/`; check with `curl` on the
deployed host, not in dev where the same files are also served directly.

## OPS-525 — LuLu on the Air: `MINIFLARE_WORKERD_PATH` also fixes `astro preview`; a symlink to an allowed `workerd` does not

`측정 2026-10-19 · MacBook Air M1 · LuLu (alert mode) · astro 7.3.3 preview · @astrojs/cloudflare 14.3.2 · workerd 1.20261012.1`

**증상:** in a new checkout, a Turnstile `siteverify` call from the Worker under `astro preview` failed after its 8 s
timeout on every request; `curl` from the same Mac answered in under a second. A probe Worker under `wrangler dev`
timed out on `https://example.com/` too (OPS-476: LuLu holds new `workerd` paths). Replacing the checkout's
`node_modules/@cloudflare/workerd-darwin-arm64/bin/workerd` with a **symlink** to an allowed binary did not help.
Starting the preview with `MINIFLARE_WORKERD_PATH=<allowed workerd of the same version>` did: the probe answered 200 in
121 ms and `siteverify` in 181 ms, and the real sign-up went through.

Also: `npm run preview -- --port 4417` runs `astro preview --host 127.0.0.1 --port 4417`, so
`pkill -f "astro preview --port 4417"` matches nothing and the old server keeps the port; the "restarted" server was
the old one. Kill by port: `kill $(lsof -ti tcp:4417 -sTCP:LISTEN)`.

**해결:** find an allowed binary of the same version (`plutil -convert xml1 -o - /Library/Objective-See/LuLu/rules.plist |
grep workerd`, then each path's `package.json` version) and export `MINIFLARE_WORKERD_PATH` for `astro preview` and
`wrangler dev` alike. Stop servers by port, not by command line.
