## OPS-750 — BetterDisplay Software Audio rejects 8-channel HDMI; stereo virtual format activates the session

`측정 2026-10-29 · BetterDisplay 5.2.1 · macOS 27.2 · Apple M1 Max`

**증상:** TOSHIBA-TV HDMI 기본 출력에서 BetterDisplay의 Software Audio 컨트롤러를 추가해도 `지원되지 않는 오디오 형식입니다. 오디오 MIDI 설정에서 출력을 확인한 다음 오디오 세션을 재시작하세요.`라고 표시됐다. Core Audio의 출력 스트림 virtual format은 48 kHz, 8채널, 32-bit float였다. 5.1.1에는 Software Audio 컨트롤러가 없었으며 `get -volume`은 `Failed.`였다.

**해결:** 5.2.1에서 디스플레이의 Device Control에 Software Audio를 추가하고, 해당 출력이 제공하는 available virtual formats 중 48 kHz, 2채널, 32-bit float를 선택해 `kAudioStreamPropertyVirtualFormat`으로 설정했다(OSStatus 0). Software Audio 설정에서 오디오 세션을 재시작하고 System Audio Recording Only 권한이 켜져 있는 것을 확인하자 `소프트웨어 오디오가 활성 상태입니다.`로 바뀌었다. CLI의 `get -name=TOSHIBA-TV -volume`은 `1.0`, `-mute`는 `off`를 반환했다. 기본 볼륨 키 처리와 현재 오디오 장치 이름에 맞춘 키보드 대상 설정을 유지한다. 메뉴의 볼륨 표시가 ‘확장되었을 때’이면 ‘표시’로 바꿔야 첫 화면에 나온다(`menuLevelVolume=less`). 스테레오 변경은 다채널 출력을 줄이므로 오디오 형식을 먼저 확인한다. 이 측정은 설정·세션 상태 확인이며 실제 스피커 음압 또는 청취 결과를 검증한 기록은 아니다.

참조: https://betterdisplay.pro/guide/interface-reference/settings/displays/display/device-control/software-audio/


## OPS-751 — Chrome on Android sends `deviceorientation` only when the phone moves, while `devicemotion` keeps coming at 60 Hz; a still phone looks like a dead sensor

`측정 2026-10-30 · Pixel 7 Pro (Android 17) · Chrome 156.0.8078.47 · installed WebAPK, standalone`

**증상:** with the phone propped still, a listener added to a live page received 0 `deviceorientation` and 171 `devicemotion` events in 3 s. That reads as "orientation is blocked", and `typeof DeviceOrientationEvent.requestPermission` being `"function"` (OPS-662) strengthens the false lead. No permission was involved: `navigator.vibrate([900,100,900,100,900])` during the same listen, which shakes the phone slightly, gave 43 `deviceorientation` events in 4 s (`beta` 69.1, `gamma` 2 to 2.1) and 83 `deviceorientationabsolute`. `devicemotion` at rest read `accelerationIncludingGravity` `(-0.1, 9.1, 3.5)`, `interval` 16.

**해결:** to test whether a phone on a desk delivers orientation at all, make it move: `navigator.vibrate` from the page is enough, no hand needed. Do not treat silence as a failure, and do not rely on one first event after adding a listener. A page that needs the current pose while the phone is still has to take it from `devicemotion`. Over CDP on a phone, take the page with `url().includes(host)`: a WebAPK opened from a shortcut carries a fragment (`https://mnori.com/#services`), so an exact URL match finds nothing.

## OPS-752 — Chromium's touch adjustment sends a tap to a nearby button even when `elementFromPoint` says the canvas

`측정 2026-10-30 · Brave 1.98 / Chromium 156 · Playwright isMobile + hasTouch at 320 × 640`

**증상:** a check tapped the centre of a ball on a canvas and expected the "kick" answer, but got the answer for a different control, only at 320 px. `document.elementFromPoint(x, y)` at the same point returned the `CANVAS`, and the tap's coordinates were exact (a capture `pointerup` listener logged `clientX`/`clientY` 250, 588), yet `event.target` was the `.cs-drop` button standing beside that spot. The same run at 390 px passed because the ball sat elsewhere, so it looked like a width bug.

**해결:** log `event.target` from a capture listener before believing `elementFromPoint`. Touch adjustment retargets a tap to a tappable element within the finger's radius, on canvases too. In a check, tap the target farthest from any control, not simply the biggest one.

## OPS-753 — Google account identifier fields can be text inputs with a tokenized username autocomplete value

\`측정 2026-10-30 · Google Ad Manager Google sign-in web UI (unversioned) · Brave on busan.mac\`

**증상:** On the Google Ad Manager sign-in page, the visible account field was \`<input id="identifierId" type="text" name="identifier" autocomplete="username webauthn">\`. Neither \`input[type="email"]\` nor the exact-value selector \`input[autocomplete="username"]\` matches it. A helper guarded by \`isVisible()\` silently skipped account entry and kept returning the empty identifier page.

**해결:** Wait for the visible \`#identifierId\`, or use the autocomplete token selector \`input[autocomplete~="username"]\`. Enter the known account identifier and inspect the resulting challenge separately. In this measurement, entering the identifier correctly reached Google's passkey challenge; an empty identifier page was a selector problem, not evidence that the account was unavailable.



## OPS-754 — Ego Lite CLI can exit 0 before onboarding without running the submitted script

`측정 2026-10-30 · ego lite macOS arm64 0.6.2.5 · ego-browser skill 2.2.0`

**증상:** After installing the official notarized app on the controller Mac, `command -v ego-browser` resolved to `~/.local/bin/ego-browser`, and `ego-browser skill` printed the complete v2.2.0 guide. However, `ego-browser nodejs -e 'console.log("ego-browser ready")'` exited 0 without printing the requested sentinel. Instead it printed: `Please complete the onboarding process first. A setup window has opened; follow the on-screen instructions to continue. After completing onboarding, open a new terminal window for the command to take effect.` The app was still at onboarding step 4 of 7, offering browser-data import. A zero exit status and an installed CLI do not establish a working browser session.

**해결:** Treat the setup as incomplete until the expected script result and actual browser state are observed. Do not count the CLI check as a passed browser test. The app automatically installed the official skill links at `~/.agents/skills/ego-browser` and `~/.claude/skills/ego-browser`; read `ego-browser skill` before using its custom API, rather than guessing Playwright APIs. At this measurement, import-access confirmation and login verification remained pending. The owner's 2026-10-30 decision makes Ego Lite the default for future browser work and supersedes the prior busan.mac/Brave browser rule; the current shared notices are first in `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md` and `~/.codex/AGENTS.md`. Do not fall back to the retired browser workflow to bypass incomplete onboarding.
